row.name: Come out, cat
row.detailed_description: Come Out, Cat is a short and simple adventure game where you call out to a cat who's hiding away, hoping to coax them back into the world. 🐈️ How to Play Choose two word cards — one action, one subject. Combine them to call out to the cat. Pay attention to how the cat reacts. Use those reactions to figure out the right words. When you find the right phrase, the cat will come out. row.name: Paradise Island 2: Hotel Game
row.detailed_description: The legendary hotel tycoon game is back! The tropical island looks as beautiful as ever, ready to house your ultimate hotel empire and receive crowds of family tourists, adventure seekers, and even virtual villagers. Develop the lost island into the most luxurious family resort in Paradise Island 2 — one of the sunniest and cutest hotel games out there. Start off with just a bunch of straw huts that provide a village life vibe on the island and build your way towards a full hotel empire with elite 5-star family accommodation fit for a world-class hotel tycoon. Make your island resort the most hyped vacation destination with all sorts of attractions, shops, and restaurants. Engage family tourists and their kids with hotel games and activities. Turn the whole island into an amusement park filled with rides, cafes, and virtual villagers, giving your guests a taste of village life. Become the ultimate hotel tycoon by expanding your influence on a lost island and tailor your hotel empire to fit the needs of even the most demanding tourists: be they young and noisy fun-seekers or reserved family people looking for safe family fun. Becoming a hotel tycoon is a serious mission, but no one says you can’t have fun on your island while you’re at it! Key features: ✔ Build over 300 buildings drawn in a unique style and make the best hotel empire ✔ Improve and develop your family island, invite and entertain guests, and earn huge profits to become the ultimate hotel tycoon ✔ Help and feed animals in danger, build your resort in tune with nature in one of the most beautiful hotel games ever ✔ Take part in competitions against friends and other city managers ✔ Play with your hotel tycoon friends: visit friends’ islands to find hidden objects and receive gifts! ✔ Unique events with special game mechanics and lots of amazing quests
row.short_description: Turn a sun-kissed island into the ultimate tropical getaway. Build luxury hotels, design beautiful beaches, and create attractions to delight your guests. Manage resources, expand your resort, and watch tourists flock to your paradise in this relaxing citybuilding game.

row.name: Astracordis Access Terminal
row.detailed_description: Astracordis is a science fiction tabletop role-playing game focused on space exploration, investigation, diplomacy, and science. It’s played using an app that includes various tools, such as character sheets and a virtual board. Although combat exists (both on foot and aboard starships), Astracordis is designed for adventures where action is usually the last resort when everything else fails. That’s why our rules include multiple ways to handle non-violent situations, and encourage characters to have a wide range of technical skills. Become a communications officer skilled at analyzing signals, a doctor specialized in exobiology, a captain capable of motivating the crew even in the worst situations, or a hacker specialized in data theft. Astracordis Access Terminal is the official app for the game, where you'll find all the tools you need to play and run your sessions. Character creator : A virtual assistant that guides you through the character creation process. Character sheet : All the information you need to manage your character (health status, level, skills, and inventory). Virtual dice : Roll dice using a virtual assistant that helps you manage your skills and bonuses. Operations : Operations are groups of complex rolls used to resolve different scenarios. Each type of operation has its own interface. Journal : Take notes during the game or expand on your character with a biography and additional details. Virtual boards : Astracordis Access Terminal includes two virtual boards—one for ground combat and another for space combat. Each has unique features and tools for the Game Master to customize the scenarios. Online Room : Astracordis supports up to six players and one Game Master. The app offers online support and shortcuts so everyone can quickly access each other’s information. GM tools : The Game Master has access to specific tools, such as a file to create boards, unique characters and items, a music player with the Original Astracordis Soundtrack, and a menu to hide dice rolls or send images to players.
row.short_description: Astracordis is a TTRPG focused on investigation, space exploration, and diplomacy. The Access Terminal is the software that provides all the tools you need to play and run your sessions: character sheets, virtual boards, dice, journal, original soundtrack, and much more.

row.name: Rock and Stone
row.detailed_description: In Rock and Stone , you are a dwarf on a mission to get rich! While you'll be mining rocks and collecting valuable loot, your true fortune is made in the player-driven market . You'll need to decide whether to sell the items you find to other players or use them to speed up your own mining. With no pay-to-win in-game purchases, your success depends entirely on your gear, luck, and determination. Gameplay Rock and Stone is a game that works for you, even when you're not playing. You will mine rocks in the background , automatically gathering Steam items . You can either sell these items on the market for a profit or open them for new gear and gold. You can occasionally click to use a limited stamina reserve to speed up mining manually. You can also purchase in-game buffs with gold you find, giving you temporary boosts. The stronger your gear, the faster you can mine and the better your chances of finding rare treasures. Looting & Gear Items come in five rarities: Common , Uncommon , Rare , Epic , and Legendary . Each rarity provides stronger stats and bigger bonuses. There are 11 stats that affect your mining, including: Magic find Damage, crit chance and crit damage multiplier Experience Buff and gold chance Buff duration and gold amount Stamina regeneration Auto-mining speed You can equip various types of gear, such as rocks , pickaxes , and pickaxe mods , to improve these stats and become an even more effective miner. Buffs & Gold While mining, you have a chance to find gold and  temporary buffs . You can also buy longer-lasting buffs with gold at any time. There are four types of buffs that can give you a boost, including: Increased damage More experience Faster auto-mining Faster stamina regeneration Reforge Reforge functionality allows you to combine 12 items of the same rarity into one new item of the next higher rarity Look out for secret recipes that don't require all 12 items! A gold cost , which varies based on the item rarity, is associated with each reforge. You can enable Reforge mode using the button in your in-game inventory. Type of the output item is affected by the distribution of the input items types. Artifacts Artifacts are collectible items that grant stat bonuses to your character as long as they remain in your Steam inventory . They’re passive, and persistent. Each artifact provides fixed bonuses. Bonuses are automatically applied when the artifact is in your Steam inventory—no need to convert them to game items, equip or activate. Artifacts come in multiple rarities , just like other in-game items. The higher the rarity, the stronger and more numerous the bonuses . Community Join the community! Connect with other miners, influence upcoming content and features, and be the first to know about events and promo codes .
row.short_description: Rock and Stone is an idle background mining game where you play as a dwarf, mining rocks for valuable loot. You can sell your loot on the community market for profit or use it to get new gear and gold. Equip different gear—from common to legendary—to boost your stats and mine even more effectively.

row.name: Duelmasters
row.detailed_description: Gameplay Each player will start the game by equipping 1 weapon and 1 ability from inside the preparation room, once both players ready up they are transported into the arena where they will duel. Players can use the arena to their advantage by interacting with scattered powerups, knocking down environmental hazards or pushing their opponent in lava. The first player to reach 3/5/7 points will be crowned the winner of the duel. Weapons Axe - Leap aggressively into fights burning the ground wherever you land, the axe is the most aggressive of the weapons designed to maintain a heavy offence. Spear - Set traps for your opponent and hurl spears of lightning at your enemy, best at keeping distance the spear is for those who prefer to play more defensively. Sword - Use your superior skill to outplay any opponent with using high mobility dashes and jumps, the sword is intended as the most flexible weapon, for both attack and defence. Abilities Dash - Weave in a dash between any ability in the game, the most skilled users create new combos by themselves. Hook- Grapple your self quickly anywhere in the arena, safely repositioning in a tight spot, alternatively pull any opponent in that is trying to escape. Repulsor Shield - Create a shield around yourself that can deflect any attack in the game with the right timing.
row.short_description: Battle your friends in fast-paced 1v1 arena brawler style duels. Choose from axe, sword, or spear, each with its own strengths, and fight through intense rounds. Outplay your opponent, become champion of the arena, and earn the title of Duelmaster!

row.name: Shidunzi Parkour
row.detailed_description: ▶︎ INTRODUCTION They were once the silent guardians of the sidewalk. Now, they are the unstoppable champions of the street! Welcome to Shidunzi Parkour ! This is a wonderfully absurd casual game where you play as... well, a stone bollard, on a wild rampage through the city. Forget superheroes and chosen ones; here, you'll experience the peak of existence as the most common, everyday roadblock. The core gameplay is a classic, intuitive three-lane runner, but we've packed it with two distinct ways to have fun: 【PARKOUR MODE: THE ART OF THE DODGE】 In this mode, you are a nimble parkour master. The streets are swarming with your stationary brethren. Rely on your sharp reflexes and precise timing to weave through the chaos, pushing your limits to set the ultimate high score. It’s not just about survival; it’s a graceful ballet of concrete and asphalt. 【MUSIC MODE: A CARNIVAL OF RHYTHMIC DESTRUCTION】 Switch to Music Mode, and let the mayhem begin! You become a rock-and-roll renegade, and your one and only goal is to SMASH EVERYTHING. Collide with other bollards in perfect sync with the electrifying beat. Every successful impact is a satisfying note in a symphony of destruction, creating the ultimate stress-relief experience. ▶︎ FEATURES Two Core Modes, Double the Fun : Master the thrilling challenge of high-speed dodging in Parkour Mode, or unleash your destructive side and smash to the beat in Music Mode. Become a Rhythm God: Full support for custom beatmaps! Craft your very own 'Bollard Symphony' and share it with players worldwide via local files or the upcoming Steam Workshop integration. Challenge the world with your unique rhythms! Online & LAN Multiplayer Mayhem : Compete with friends online or on a local network! In Parkour Mode, you'll see other players' ghost silhouettes as you race against their best runs. In Music Mode, watch a live leaderboard and battle for the top score in real-time! Host Your Own Game with Ease : No dedicated server required! The game client itself can act as a server. Simply share your IP address, and you can instantly start a LAN party with your friends. The Ultimate Stress-Relief Tool : Become a bollard. Run wild. Forget the rules. This might just be the most absurdly satisfying and relaxing game you'll ever play. Are you ready? Pick your mode, hit the streets, and show the world what a stone bollard can really do!
row.short_description: Ever looked at a humble street bollard and thought, 'I want to be that'? Now you can! Dodge and crash your way through endless streets as a sentient stone bollard in this quirky, stress-relieving arcade game.

row.name: Fly Over! 100KM! Mountains!
row.detailed_description: Take to the boundless skies with your little plane! Fly through clouds and obstacles, feeling the wind whipping through your wings—but remember, your true enemy isn't just the obstacles ahead; it's the roaring tornado behind you. It's closing in on you, and all you can do is accelerate, dodge, and persevere...    Your goal is one: fly over 100 kilometers and claim that untouchable medal of honor. This is not only a test of skill, but also a test of will.    Simple rules, pure challenge: every move determines how far you can fly.    —Are you ready for this marathon in the sky?   ⌨️ Keyboard Controls: ↑ ↓ ← → / WSAD Boost: Spacebar Pause: ESC key   🎮 Gamepad Controls: Left Stick Boost: B Pause: Y

Chess With Idiots
row.detailed_description: Outthink. Outlast. Outplay. Step into a tactical roguelike where every battle is a puzzle, every move matters, and defeat is just the start of the story! Assemble your team of unique idiots and fight through 4 dangerous regions — each with its own enemies, gimmicks, and secrets... From goblin ambushes in dense forests to mind-bending traps in a forgotten library, every encounter forces you to adapt your strategy. Chess with Idiots is a turn based strategy roguelike. You control a self made team of 'Idiots' with the goal of completing as many runs as possible. A run starts at the forest and ends at the final boss on top of the volcano. Finishing a run allows you to either continue, or completely end your run. If you decide to continue, you restart at the forest but will notice that all the enemies have become a lot stronger... Key Features Custom turn order - Determine the order of actions yourself and create the optimal strategy.        Four Distinct Regions – Forest, Cave, Library, and Volcano — each with unique visuals, challenges, and bosses. Roguelike Progression – Unlock new characters, abilities, and strategies with each run. Dynamic Encounters – No two battles play out the same thanks to randomized enemy setups. Environmental Hazards – Lava flows, collapsing tiles, magical anomalies, and more keep the battlefield alive. Handcrafted 2D Art & Effects – Colorful environments and smooth animations bring each region to life. Will you conquer the dragon at the heart of the volcano… or become just another hero swallowed by the flames? DISCLAIMER ! This game is not a variant of chess, it is it's own concept but influenced by the game of chess.
row.short_description: Shape the turn order in a speed-based tactical roguelike. Adapt to shifting battlefields, overcome unique bosses, and unlock powerful new abilities as you guide a band of idiots through four perilous and distinct regions!

Luminaria
row.detailed_description: The light has faded, and the world has sunk into silence and darkness. Only one beacon rises above the endless expanse, and only you can ignite its light. To awaken the beacon, you must journey through gloomy locations and collect the stars scattered across the world. Each one is a fragment of the lost light, and only by gathering them all will you be able to dispel the darkness. Luminaria is a meditative journey where the focus is not on speed but on atmosphere. The world responds to your presence, and your path is filled with soft radiance that step by step brings back hope. The sole grand goal — collect all the stars to activate the main beacon. Atmospheric world — a blend of darkness and light in a minimalist visual style. Meditative gameplay — no battles or timers, just you and a peaceful adventure. Smooth animation and light effects — creating the feeling of a living world. Musical accompaniment — a gentle soundtrack that enhances the atmosphere of the journey.

row.name: #Oyster Sooource 2120bb
row.detailed_description: Idle, upgrade, and outsmart your enemies in fast-paced, Pac-Man-style stages! Let auto-play grind coins for you (it’s not as good as you are—trust me), or take control and go for risky, high-reward runs. Team up with allies, dodge quirky enemies, and collect keys to unlock the way forward. Features Auto-Play: Earn coins while you’re away, but don’t expect flawless gameplay—keep it on the safe stages! Upgrade & Deploy Allies: Buy allies, place them strategically, and pass by to trigger their help. Pac-Man-Inspired Action: Weave through speeding, shooting, and even flying enemies while hunting keys. Failure-Friendly: Lose only your earnings and allies—jump back in as many times as you want. New & Improved from the Browser Version Smoother controls A more welcoming tutorial to get you started
row.short_description: Destruction is Pleasure! Idle, upgrade, and dodge enemies in a Pac-Man-style action game with allies and endless retries.

row.name: Duet Night Abyss
row.detailed_description: In the long and repetitive dream, Quicksand constantly pours down. The compass of destiny starts to tick. The two wake up and embark on their separate journeys. On this shore, you emerged from a perilous situation but were exiled to the harsh North Border, struggling to survive. On the other shore, you found yourself in a maelstrom of power, striving to escape from a cage woven with conspiracies. No need to bid farewell. As time perpetually flows forward, As the two shores will eventually meet, You will meet each other one day. Duet Night Abyss is a fantasy adventure RPG with a high degree of freedom developed by Hero Games' Pan Studio. The game features 'Multiple Weapon Loadouts x 3D Combat' at its core, and tells the story of 'Demons' from dual perspectives. [Craft your own lineup] Freely farm character fragments and forging materials to unlock your favorite characters and weapons at your own pace. No forced progression, no rigid templates—just the joy of free cultivation and strategic experimentation. Focus on strengthening your core squad or exploring endless tactical possibilities. [Destinies intertwine — Meet demons of a hundred faces in the DNA] You will step into a land where magic and machinery coexist, playing as two protagonists with vastly different backgrounds. Encounter a variety of demonic beings with their own perspectives as you engage in constant battles and exploration to uncover the truth behind a thorny fate, ultimately bringing an end to the spiral of suffering. [Swap between melee & ranged weapons — Freely create multi‑dimensional weapon combos] In battles, you can freely switch between melee and ranged weapons, allowing characters to break free from the limitations of a single weapon class. Choose from a variety of cool melee weapons such as whipblades, crossbows, and even heavy firepower like sniper rifles, grenade launchers, and high-tech hover guns to create your unique weapon loadouts. [Exhilarating hack‑and‑slash battles — Master agile moves and mow down hordes] Engage in fast-paced combat against waves of relentless enemies with the freedom to utilize both close and long-range attacks, as well as aerial assaults and ground takedowns. Bask in unexpected and thrilling battle experiences through diverse combat gameplay including tracking, reconnaissance, and rescue missions. [Customize your look with dyes — Mix & match—colour weapons & outfits freely] Dye and switch at will—take full control of your weapon and character aesthetics. Swap color schemes on the fly to match your combat style with your personal flair. Combine a wealth of accessories—from elegant headpieces to lively waist ornaments—whether for refined beauty or playful fun, the choice is yours.
row.short_description: A Thrilling Hybrid Action RPG, featuring a Dual Narrative

row.name: Samuel Prince Attorney at Law Chapter 1

Acquire evidence by investigating the crime scene, then use it in court when cross examining witnesses to cleave through all the lies and find your way to the truth. In this chapter, Samuel Prince makes his grand debut in the courtroom, defending a young college girl accused of killing her best friend.
row.short_description: The first of seven chapters of a courtroom battle style visual novel, in which the story follows brand new lawyer Samuel Prince as he solves a strange variety of different crimes. row.name: Sport Animals
row.detailed_description: Sport Animals is all about getting out onto the field and scoring goals! Pick out your animal's style from a myriad of options and start playing, either with friends or in public lobbies with other online players. Games only take 5 minutes and support all team sizes between 1v1 and 3v3. You can also spectate games for a more cinematic experience! Game Features Character Customization:  Thousands of combinations of animals, colors, and accessories No Scripted Mechanics:  Physics-based ball and character movement Play with Anyone:  Public and friend-based lobby options Custom Lobbies:  Customize all game settings from the lobby, including gravity, shot speed, and more Always Free All cosmetics are immediately available for your use. Sport Animals is all about making the animal you want and having fun in game, so we'll never add microtransactions or paywalled items to the game. The game and its content will always be 100% free!
row.short_description: Sport Animals is a physics-based game about a group of animals playing a sport! Customize your animal, practice your game, and get onto the field start scoring goals in 1v1s, 2v2s, or 3v3s. Compete against your friends or join public lobbies to play against other animals!

row.name: Myrkwood: Offshoot
row.detailed_description: Myrkwood: Offshoot is a top-down survival defense game that you can play with your friends! Spawn with 5 other people and defend the objective, the Gem, as Bombrats and hordes of monsters attempt to try to crack it. Dodge, slash, & fight as you attempt to try to get the highest waves survived. Features Online/local multiplayer - You and 5 other players can join the same lobby and defend the Gem together! Upgrade your character! Buy upgrades & items to help you defend the Gem! Chat with friends! Chat with your friends to help coordinate and communicate better! Nice pixel art graphics! Well, at least we think so.  Endless waves! Fight through endless waves with increasing difficulty.  Dungeon crawler! Run through endless rooms & fight through hordes of monsters as you try to get the highest completed room counts.  Enemy variants! Enemies become more difficult by becoming stronger and having multiple powers to try to kill you! :)
row.short_description: Myrkwood: Offshoot is a top-down survival defense game that you can play with friends! Defend the Gem as you fight through waves of enemies!

row.name: Champions of The Cosmos
row.detailed_description: Champions of the Cosmos is a retro sci-fi RTS inspired by 80's action figures, comics and movies. Play heroes with the power to reshape the landscape around them and other unique abilities to take over the cosmos and choose whichever side you sympathize with most - light or darkness.  Developed as a vertical slice in just four months, this student project presents a playable demo that offers a first glimpse of our vision. Terraforming Harness the power of the rare ore Terranium to reshape the battlefield in the heat of combat. Raise hills and mountains to your advantage or tear open the ground and hurl your enemies into the planet’s core. Even greater powers await those who master the Terranium Laboratory , where new abilities can be researched and unleashed. Light and Darkness   Choose which side you will conquer the galaxy with, light or darkness. Each faction offers unique heroes and slightly different mechanics. All units on both sides are fully and authentically voice-acted. Game Modes In Champions of the Cosmos , you can choose between three modes. Learn the basics of both factions, combat, and general gameplay flow in the Tutorial. Embark on a narrative-driven journey in the Campaign, or challenge yourself against the AI in Skirmish-Mode, on three distinct maps to test your skills and mastery of the game.

Play heroes with the power to reshape the landscape around them and other unique abilities to take over the cosmos and choose whichever side you sympathize with most - light or darkness.

row.short_description: 《Alien Brothers 2》is a top-down ARPG. Loot dark fantasy gear with random stats, runes, and upgrades. Skills auto-fire. Control everything with just a mouse or an Xbox controller. Rise from nothing, defeat the Demon King's legion, and save the galaxy!

row.name: The Day of the Jellyfish
row.detailed_description: Your friendly neighborhood soft drink corporation has been polluting the ocean and mutating the local sea life, just as the 80s' newest upcoming band BLUEBERRY FINN is entering town for a show. Hank and Duck need to split up if they're going to stop the evil that is afoot, and save all the beach-goers from being jellied! Escape from the Jellyfish is a point-and-click comedy adventure game featuring original pixel-art and music, quirky puzzles, and fully voice acted dialogue. The story revolves around two protagonists, Hank and Duck, who only showed up in town to put on a rockin' concert, but ended up smack dab in the middle of a mutating fizzy-based pollution catastrophe.   FEATURES: - Play as TWO different characters, classic adventure game style. - AQUA based puzzles that will get stuck in your brain for hours! - Learn about the environment and what to do to protect it!  - Feel like you are in '80 again! (Or for the first time. I'm looking at you, Generation Z). - Defeat the Evil Jellyfish! - Beautiful OST
row.short_description: A point-and-click comedy adventure game featuring original pixel-art and music, quirky puzzles, and fully voice acted dialogue. row.name: Do NOT say 21!
row.detailed_description: Layla is bored and wants to play a game with you. According to her, you must take turns counting upwards in groups of up to 3. But you must count in a way that you don’t end up being the one to say the number 21.  Actually requires your brain While her game’s premise is staggeringly simple, it will require the use of some of your finest brain cells to figure out how to beat her. And if you do, you’ll get an achievement.  Gameplay: The 'How to play' trailer is for entertainment purposes only. When you actual play the 21 game, Layla will not tolerate any funny business. You can only play by the rules - there are no dialog options for illegal game moves. The goal is simply to beat her 3x in a row for the achievement. Controls: Press spacebar to count when it’s your turn. Included with your purchase: A simple but perplexing arithmetic challenge Single button gameplay Achievements Spoken dialog with subtitles The numbers 1 through 21 An annoying girl (ft Layla)  DLC and extras: If you've enjoyed counting with Layla, there are some optional donation DLCs available which allow you to take Layla to new locations.
row.short_description: A free AI slop counting game, where the objective is simply to avoid the number 21. Do you have enough brain cells to win?

row.name: Eyes of Hellfire Friend's Pass
row.detailed_description: Eyes of Hellfire is an atmospheric gothic horror experience for you and up to 4 of your friends. Based on real Irish legends of the secret society known as the Hellfire Club, in Eyes of Hellfire you and your friends are trapped within the club’s headquarters, an abandoned hunting lodge. Enter the grounds of the Hellfire Club, cautiously explore, co-operate, evade the violent entities within the lodge, and discover what you can while you each attempt to lift your curse. Escape before your soul is lost. Be warned! In these walls something, or someone, is always lying. By downloading the Eyes of Hellfire   Friend's Pass* , up to 4 friends can play Eyes of Hellfire for free when 1 friend owns the game. 1. Own Eyes of Hellfire 2. Friends download Friend's Pass 3. Owner invites friends to play via Steam 4. Play the full first scenario together! *Full game ownership includes meta character progression, additional card unlocks, and customisation. These are unavailable when playing using the Friend’s Pass You and your friends play as a small group of unfortunate people who have recently discovered that they have each become a victim of a potentially fatal curse. They have hiked through the thick woods of the Dublin mountains and travelled to the ruins of the Hellfire Club in the hopes of discovering what connects them to this place and what, or who, has brought this curse upon them all. You and your team have a common goal of escaping the haunted lodge while also defeating the Antagonist. But you each also have hidden solo objectives. Which will you prioritize? You must succeed at both to win. Use proximity voice chat to plot together with teammates, as well as question their motives. Choose from a variety of characters, with their own strengths, weaknesses, and goals. Your choice will impact what you see in each play session; you’ll have to decide if it’s real or not Build your hand of actions: Each playthrough you start with a hand of cards that equal actions that can be done each turn, limited by your action points. As you explore the lodge, you’ll discover new and better action cards to alter your playthrough.

row.name: BIRDHOUSE
row.detailed_description: BIRDHOUSE is a short interactive horror experience created by HELLLST4R featuring hand drawn graphics, animated cutscenes, and an original soundtrack. Wick, a young human-like creature, lives in a secluded forest home with a loving deity. As he completes chores around the house and discovers a mysterious abandoned egg in the backyard, he must grapple with visions and strange occurrences that begin to plague his once tranquil home. All is not as it seems in this quiet house... FEATURES Narrative-driven eldritch horror game Digitally painted graphics and animated cutscenes An original ambient soundtrack  Walking simulator that uses key items and interactables to progress the story Collectible pages that provide world-building exposition Short playtime, meant to be completed in one sitting  IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS: Please contact me at helllst4r@gmail.com with details about the issue you encountered so I can quickly fix it.
row.short_description: A short narrative-driven horror game made in RPGmaker featuring hand-drawn graphics and animated cutscenes. Players navigate the house and its backyard, interacting with the environment and collecting key items to progress the story.

row.name: PANTSU: Atty's Collection
row.detailed_description: PANTSU: Atty’s Collection is a casual online single-player collecting game, where you help Atty, Mizu, Sasa, and Rikki collect a constantly growing list of panties in the world. Fill up your collection, earn panty points, and use those panty points to unlock higher levels and more outfits to customize your own member! Brief Story: Atty is the founder of Atty’s Secret Base, which is a secret organization designed to find and collect (steal) panties. PANTSU is a specialized team that stands for the “Panty Acquisition Network, Team Star Unit,” which specializes in stealing panties directly from people to add to the collection. Atty, Mizu, Rikki, and Sasa (with the panda bears) are the main members of PANTSU, and need your help to collect them all! Game Style: Each of the characters has their own unique style of collecting panties. Atty has a reaction time method of collecting panties, where you will need to press the screen when the yellow bar is within the pink circle. Mizu is very calculated in her approach to collecting panties. Solve “simple” math problems to find a way to collect panties with her method. Sasa's style is based on her ability to manage the little pandas she takes care of. She helps control the chaos that the pandas make when collecting panties. Tap on the circles in order from lowest to highest to collect panties. Rikki’s style simulates the complex maneuvers she makes with her tail to collect panties. Drag the coin through the maze, collect the keys to open the door, and drop the coin into the treasure chest. Collection: Fill up your panty collection in each stage. Each character has their own Legendary panty that reflects a portion of their personality. Mizu, Sasa, and Rikki each have their own variety of legendary panties they can find, so mastering all the styles of play is needed to complete the collection! Progression: Each panty, based on rarity, will earn you panty points. These panty points can be redeemed to increase your level, which will unlock more stages and more outfits for your member to buy. Check the leaderboard to determine your rank in Atty's Secret Base! Character Customization: You can build your own member in Atty’s Secret Base, and you can currently use your member to stop thieves from stealing your properly stolen panties! More features will be coming soon.
row.short_description: A casual anime game with mini-games to collect panties, which are used to rank up, unlock levels, and buy items to customize your own character. Lighthearted with funny descriptions.
row.notes: Includes and primarily consists of acts of stealing panties from other people, which is an action that some may deem as sexual assault, however, such actions are intended to be assault without sexual undertones.

row.name: UCISMA
row.detailed_description: A Music-Powered Planet, UCISMA 「Music is the lifeblood of this planet, formed by the fusion of Rhythm, Melody, and Harmony.」 UCISMA is a top-down rhythm action game where players move in sync with the beat. One day, Music vanished from the music-powered planet Ucisma due to the loss of three Absolute Artifacts. To restore it, the Supreme Elder took up the legendary sword. Now you, as the Supreme Elder, embark on a journey to reclaim Music. Move dynamically to each stage’s rhythm and purify Ucisma! How To Play Attack: Left-click on mouse Dash: Right-click on mouse Move: WASD Game Description - This game is a rhythm action top view game. - Use the mouse for non-game menus. - Each stage has different background music and hazards. - You have to operate to the beat and survive until the music is over. - If the stage is successful, the next stage will be opened. Additional Description - The length of the music varies from stage to stage, usually around a minute or two. - The higher the score, the better the stage rating. - You can read the story with the book-shaped icon at the bottom of the stage selection. Etc. Tutorial play and random line description right before entering the stage, will go a long way towards gameplay! (The 'HOW TO PLAY' button on the main screen enters the tutorial)
row.short_description: UCISMA is a top-down rhythm action game where players move in sync with the beat. One day, Music vanished from the music-powered planet Ucisma. Now you, as the Supreme Elder, embark on a journey to reclaim Music. Move dynamically to each stage’s rhythm and purify Ucisma!

row.name: Yinglet Creator
row.detailed_description: Yinglet Creator lets you create yinglets. It's a small, free, fan-made character creator. What's a 'Yinglet'? They're a fictional species from the long-running webcomic: Out-of-Placers by Val Salia. What can I customize? Eyes, hair, fur patterns, clothes, and much more with over 200 toggles Fully recolor anything Adjust proportions with a bunch of sliders What can I do with my yinglets? Save them, share them with friends, and take pictures. A dedicated photo mode lets you pose your creations. Is there any gameplay? Nope! Just the character creator.
row.short_description: A character creator that lets you design your very own collection of yinglets.
row.notes: While Yinglet Creator has no explicit sexual content, it includes suggestive elements like jiggle physics, revealing outfits, and provocative poses.

row.name: Gravity
row.detailed_description: Gravity is a difficult but rewarding platforming game about a lost astronaut on a journey to find his spaceship and return to planet Earth. Sadly, his jetpack has lost all its fuel and the only way to guide him home is to manipulate the gravitational field around him with the one of a kind Grav-o-Ball (patent pending). Along the way, encounter friends, foes, and other out-of-this-world oddities on your journey through outer space. Features: Explore 15+ handcrafted levels brimming with extraterrestrial life. Navigate through complex terrain and obstacles to find the end of each level. Use physics to your advantage! Pilot the player through hazardous terrain with gravity as your tool. Play levels to your heart's content and race to beat your own high score. Collect stars! These elusive prizes are hidden carefully throughout each level. Oh, and watch out for the aliens! :) Controls: The controls for this game are very simple: move the Grav-o-Ball with your mouse. The affects of its gravity only extend to the boundaries of the circle, so make sure to keep the player within the Grav-o-Ball.
row.short_description: Gravity is a platformer/obstacle game where your only tool is to use a gravitational field to guide an astronaut through space. With a custom built physics engine, pull him through each level, dodging asteroids and other harmful space objects along the way.

row.name: 50 Minutes 'Til Impact
row.detailed_description: ABOUT: Play as Clara , a passenger aboard The Comet , a malfunctioning space train, who finds herself stuck in an endless time loop. With only 50-minute intervals before a  collision with an asteroid, you must outwit unseen forces to stop this catastrophe and save the lives of everyone on board. Hopefully everyone plans on playing nice... Keyword: 'hopefully.' MECHANICS: Traverse - You're not solely bound to your written choices; feel free to roam about the cabin! You've got a whole space train to explore! Interact - Moving next to doors, people, and even objects may allow you to interact with them, where you can get information, pick up items, travel through train cars, and maybe even be prompted to use a specific item to progress the story forward! Puzzle Solve - Throughout your narrative journey, you may encounter some obstacles that will challenge you to use the information and items you have collected in your inventory to figure out a security passcode or solve a puzzle!
row.short_description: 50 Minutes 'Til Impact is set in a retro-futuristic world aboard an advanced, yet luxurious space train! It's a linear narrative adventure where players utilize 3D exploration, code solving, and visual novel interactions to do whatever they can to save everyone on board before time runs out.
row.notes: 50 Minutes Til Impact has many high stakes of life-and-death. Although there may be some violent acts, we do not go into detail nor attempt to make your narrative experience unpleasant to the eyes or mind.

row.name: SpikerMan Game
row.detailed_description: SpikerMan is an RPG with a large explorable world, colorful characters, and uses the LMBS (Linear Motion Battle System), a combat system that takes place in real time. Use a variety of attacks that can be equipped at once by using a combination of one button and holding down the movement buttons.  Level up to learn new attacks for you and your teammates. Along his journey he will fight against  a great number of foes, evil space emperors, crime lords, pirates, overlords, and even space gods. Gather your teammates, journey to other planets, complete side quests, gain power, and save the universe!

圣域传奇：永恒之战
row.detailed_description: 圣域传奇：永恒之战版本介绍 一、 核心概念：当玛法大陆遇上那美克星 🌏 耗时两年精心雕琢，倾尽心血打造诚意巨献！《圣域传奇：永恒之战》以原创剧情为灵魂的基础上，深度植入了日本动漫《七龙珠》的元素💫，它保留了传奇的核心玩法（打怪、升级、爆装备、攻沙巴克）超级大陆为舞台🏰，秉持“不肝不氪”的友好理念💖，同时增加了龙珠系统、气功波、战斗力、赛亚人变身等独具特色的新内容，让游戏体验既怀旧又新奇，该版本节奏非常快，开局送高级技能🎮，升级迅猛，龙珠易得，PK更爽快，主打一个“爽”字，为玩家开启一场别具一格的传奇冒险之旅🚀。 二、 主要特色与玩法系统 🎮 龙珠系统（核心玩法）🔮 掉落来源 ： 游戏中的各种BOSS甚至高级小怪，在被打败后都有概率掉落“龙珠”（一星珠到九星珠）💎。 升星 ： 当玩家集齐九颗龙珠后，可以在特定NPC（如神龙）处进行升星，是玩家快速提升实力的关键途径✨。 气功与buff系统 💨 替代传统属性 ： 在这个版本中，玩家的强度往往不再单纯看“攻击力-防御力”，而是引入了“战斗力”这个概念，更贴合龙珠的世界观🌌。 气功波技能 ： 玩家可以学习并释放各种气功波技能，例如： 龟派气功： 远程直线攻击，伤害极高🐢💥。 爆裂魔冲：攻击目标，使敌方冰冻❄️。 超级能量球：使周围敌人致盲（石化效果）👀💤。 终级闪光：可使敌人触发减速效果💫🚶‍♂️。 超级爆力魔波： 玩家可以积攒“气”，然后开启“爆气”状态，短时间内大幅提升攻击力、速度和战斗力💪💨。 神王重炮：可免疫敌方攻击🛡️💥。 星球毁灭弹：攻击目标可增加吸血效果🌍🩸。 自在极意功：直接斩杀目标的血量🗡️💀。 赛亚人变身系统 🦸‍♂️ 核心特色 ： 这是该版本最吸引人的系统之一。玩家通过使用道具晋升时装，可以激活赛亚人血脉💪👽。 地图与BOSS创新 🗺️ 游戏中会增加基于龙珠题材的地图，例如： 那美克星： 高级地图，里面的怪物可能是弗利萨、基纽特战队成员等👾🌠。 经典BOSS： 沙鲁、布欧、贝吉塔、弗利萨等动漫中的反派都会作为超级BOSS出现，击败他们会掉落极品装备和高级龙珠👹🎁。 装备系统 🛡️ 装备体系在传统传奇装备（屠龙、嗜魂法杖等）之上，增加了大量龙珠主题装备🗡️🔮。 三、 总结 🎉 传奇七龙珠版本是一款极具想象力的创新玩法。它成功地将两款经典IP的优点结合： 传奇的PVP核心与社交体系（沙巴克攻城、行会战）🏰👥。 龙珠的成长感与爆发力（收集龙珠、变身、释放气功波）🔮💥。 它满足了玩家在熟悉的世界里追求更高层次力量巅峰的梦想——想象一下，在沙巴克战场上，一个“超级赛亚人”战士顶着金光，一发出龟派气功轰倒一片敌人的场景🦸‍♂️💥，这种体验是原版传奇无法提供的。对于既喜欢传奇又热爱龙珠的玩家来说，这无疑是一个不容错过的神奇版本🎮🌟。

row.name: AboJam
row.detailed_description: The tranquility of day, and the tension of night. During the day, you'll feel a quiet sense of achievement as you tend to your farm. The process of touching the soil and planting seeds calms a restless mind. This is your healing. But when night falls, uninvited guests appear, seeking your harvest. They are a nuisance that shatters your peace. You must respond to this problem using the avocados you grew during the day. Slow the enemy's approach with hard avocados, and install attack avocados behind them to systematically thwart their invasion. Protecting my space with cool-headed wisdom. Every night, your farm becomes a testing ground for your plan. GAMEPLAY The tranquility of farm management and the intellectual challenge of fending off an invasion. A turn-based defense game where two kinds of fun coexist. 『AboJam』 is a game where the healing time of cultivating your farm intersects with the time for meticulous strategy to protect its fruits. Plan and Grow (Day): The day turn is all yours. Plan how you will arrange your avocados. The landscape of your farm and the efficiency of your defense at night will change according to your plan. Respond and Block (Night): When the night turn begins, the gangs move in an organized manner. They are a threat, but not an unpredictable one. It's time for the defense system you designed to operate. Control the enemy's path with obstacles and neutralize intruders with attack towers. Sometimes, you can even intervene directly.
row.short_description: Manage your own farm in a turn-based defense game, and fend off swarming gangs with avocado towers you've grown yourself.

row.name: ステータス確認探偵
row.detailed_description: Stats don't lie. The protagonist has given up being an adventurer and become a detective. An incident occurs at a bar he happens to stop by! 'Detectives in this world can peek into the stats of others.' Use these words to solve the case! Overview This is a first-person mystery adventure in which you investigate cases while monitoring the stat screen. Use stats and deduction to uncover the truth. In the main story , you unravel the mystery of a strange incident that took place in 'Omland,' a parallel world ruled by stats. Completing the main story unlocks the following substories. Extra A sequel to the main story. Another Episode Take on a new incident that takes place in the real world. Play Mode Easy The number of choices is reduced. Normal Standard mode. Hard You can take on the 'Challenge to the Reader.' This mode requires a broad perspective and deep reasoning. Play Time 2 hours Hard Mode will take longer. Multiplayer Mode Invite online friends to join the game and enjoy the story together. The host handles all basic operations, but all players can individually view logs and investigation materials. Work together to uncover the truth.
row.short_description: Check the suspect's status and solve the mystery! A status-checking mystery ADV in which a rookie detective takes on difficult cases that take place in a fantasy world.

row.name: Inotia 4
row.detailed_description: The grand adventure across the continent of Inotia begins, following the intertwined fates of Kiyan, an assassin of the Dark Clan, and Yusha, the saint of light. Experience an emotional story and thrilling, fast-paced battles in this epic action RPG. ⚔️ Key Features Epic Storyline Follow the dramatic tale of Kiyan, the assassin of the Dark Clan, and Yusha, the saint of light, as their destinies collide across the vast land of Inotia. Six Unique Classes Choose from six distinctive classes — Black Knight, Assassin, Warlock, Priest, Ranger, or Warrior — and create your own combat style. Strategic Party System Recruit mercenaries with over 20 unique skills to build your own party and devise tactical strategies for every battle. Vast World Exploration Journey through more than 400 regions — from scorching deserts and frozen tundras to mysterious forests and dark dungeons — uncovering hidden treasures and secrets along the way.
row.short_description: The grand adventure of Kiyan, assassin of the Dark Clan, and Yusha, saint of light, begins across the vast continent of Inotia. Experience an emotional story and thrilling, action-packed combat!

row.name: BALANCED FOOD CalorieMate FOR GAME CREATORS - JELLY MISSION -
row.detailed_description: Calorie Mate has created a game! And the second edition is here at last! This year it’s JELLY! Transform into a Calorie Mate JELLY and deliver nutrition to a game creator immersed in work. This action-adventure takes you on a journey through an apartment room. About the Game You control a Calorie Mate JELLY pouch that has jumped out of the fridge and guide it toward the goal. To complete the game, your pouch must reach the hand of the game creator in the workroom deep in [KG1] the apartment. The JELLY’s temperature will rise with time and other factors. Try to get it to the goal at as chilled a temperature as possible. As you go, various obstacles will block the JELLY and threaten its power gauge. When the gauge hits zero, the game is over. row.short_description: Transform into a Calorie Mate JELLY and deliver nutrition to a game creator immersed in work. This action-adventure takes you on a journey through an apartment room.

row.name: Lady Umbrella
row.detailed_description: Lady Umbrella is a 3d action-adventure shooter in which the player plays the role of special agent Francesca De Angelis (aka Lady Umbrella) who, while infiltrating the last mafia family in Italy, is betrayed and incriminated by her partner and must now clear her name by preventing her own agency from arresting her and defeating the mafia using her main weapon: a shotgun umbrella that when opened functions as a shield and multiple gadgets. Close the gap to your enemies Use the umbrella-shield and the different traversal mechanics to finish them off with a shotgun blast. Various multi-purpose gadgets  Make your way through your adventure! Multi-Function Umbrella Mechanics Switch between combat, traversal, and puzzle-solving tools — the umbrella isn’t just a weapon, it’s your lifeline. Espionage Meets Mafia Drama Uncover a web of betrayal and deceit as Lady Umbrella fights to clear her name in her own agency while taking on the ultimate Italian Mafia family. Live a frenetic experience in a sprawling Italian Mediterranean city besieged by the mafia. This game is a university project carried out by students at U-tad. The master's degrees involved are design, art, programming, modeling, animation, rigging, and production at U-tad, in addition to the degree in music creation and production at Loyola University.
row.short_description: Wield your high-tech umbrella to take down Italy’s last mafia family while evading capture by your own agency in this thrilling third-person action-adventure shooter.

row.name: an unplayable game?!
row.detailed_description: A short game about the importance of accessibility. This game explores the impact of accessibility settings through a short, playable experience, forcing players to confront exactly how it feels... to play an unplayable game . an unplayable game?! is not a typical platformer. It is designed to test your  understanding of movement mechanics, turning every jump into a micro-puzzle... to complete it, you'll have to rely on problem-solving instead of dexterity. Aggressively human. Proudly made over the course of 140+ hours of human effort (the trailer was made at 120 hours but i did a LOT more bug-fixing and polish afterwards), this game contains NO generative AI output, and AI was not used in any capacity during the game's construction. This is my first solo game, and that's important to me. I made it, I made uncountable decisions to bring it into existence, and so I documented it... ...with over 30 minutes of developer commentary. ~25 commentary tracks, totaling over 30 minutes, spread across the game to give players a peek behind the curtain during their second playthrough. Tracks go over the how and why I made an unplayable game?! , firmly anchoring the human artistry into the game itself.
row.short_description: a game about accessibility settings that's just a *bit* too hard for you to play effectively. 10-15 minutes in length with 30+ minutes of developer commentary!
row.reviews: “A short but thoughtful exercise in accessible game design.... For players and developers alike, I can highly recommend An Unplayable Game.” Marijn Rongen, 'Can I Play That?!' Indie Spotlight

row.name: Wanech's C.A.N.
row.detailed_description: After wrapping up the hit Amborettio , Wanech transformed his trusty C.A.N. into a cozy green-themed pub serving brew, burgers, fries, and wings. The place hums with synthwave tracks, punctuated by chiptune sound effects, giving it a playful retro vibe. In this top-down, casual cooking sim with arcade twists , you’ll serve hungry customers by cooking food in a unique way: as meals rain down the screen, hit the correct W, A, S, D keys in sequence to prepare each order. Master the rhythm of the kitchen and deliver every plate! Nobody really knows why Wanech traded adventure for appetizers—though rumor has it, it’s all to raise awareness for Amborettio . Whatever the reason, your mission is clear: keep the pub buzzing, the customers smiling, and the orders flowing! Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
row.short_description: Wanech’s C.A.N. becomes a retro green pub serving brew, burgers, fries, and wings to synthwave beats. In this top-down cooking sim, prep meals by hitting W/A/S/D in sequence as orders rain down. Keep plates moving, customers smiling, and the pub buzzing!

row.name: 荒岛钓鱼记
row.detailed_description: This is a little side project my studio and I put together in our spare time. It doesn’t have much gameplay, so we hope you’ll understand. We also took this chance to get familiar with Steam’s various processes and features. More games will be launched on Steam in the future—follow our Bilibili account 'EP Niu Juzhang' for updates on new releases (assuming we don’t sign with a publisher).
row.short_description: This is a desktop mini-game. Tim will be your desktop pet, fishing non-stop until he catches a palm-sized fish.You can put the caught items into the fish tank or sell them to exchange for costume items.

row.name: Echoes of the Court
row.detailed_description: Experience a stunningly detailed 3D recreation of the Supreme Court of Canada. From the grand courtroom to rarely seen chambers closed to the public, every corner holds history, and every story you uncover will shape the writer you become. You play as a maintenance worker who also dreams of becoming an author, roaming the building at night in search of inspiration. As you make your way through the quiet halls, you hear mysterious echoes — fragments of conversations from citizens, attorneys, and judges whose lives once crossed here. These voices, along with scraps of paper and hidden mementos, reveal emotional and often surprising stories that become the seeds for the characters in your own novel. Explore hidden areas of the Supreme Court not normally open to visitors. Hear touching testimonials based on real events that changed Canadian rights and freedoms. Learn about Canada’s legal and cultural history through intimate, human perspectives. The choices you make — which trait you give your characters, what inspires you most — shape the novel you create. At the end, compare your story to friends and see how your interpretations differ. Perfect for fans of contemplative and narrative games, Echoes of the Court offers a relaxed pace where exploration, listening, and discovery are at the heart of the experience. Whether you’re here for the history, the human stories, or simply a meditative game session, you’ll leave with something to reflect on. Produced by the University of Ottawa and its Jurivision team, the audiovisual platform for law. Developed by Affordance Studio in collaboration with Awastoki and a team of professors and students. This initiative has been made possible thanks to the financial support and collaboration of our institutional partners: Government of Canada, Notarial Studies Fund of the Chambre des notaires du Québec, Barreau du Québec, Federation of Law Societies of Canada, Law Foundation of Ontario, Alberta Law Foundation, New Brunswick Law Foundation, Law Foundation of Saskatchewan, Law Foundation of Nova Scotia, Law Foundation of Newfoundland & Labrador, Canadian Bar Association’s Law for the Future Fund, Centre for Environmental Law and Global Sustainability at the University of Ottawa, Royal Canadian Mint, CBC/Radio-Canada, and the Supreme Court of Canada.
row.short_description: Step into the Supreme Court of Canada in a touching narrative adventure. Explore hidden rooms, hear untold stories that shaped the nation, and craft your own novel inspired by the people whose lives changed here.

row.name: Grunt - The Wrestling Game
row.detailed_description: (To get the most out of this game - please download the game manual!) Windows only - not sure how it runs on a Mac. GRUNT - The Wrestling Game Step into the ring and take control! Welcome to GRUNT - The Wrestling Game , the ultimate text-based wrestling simulation! This isn't about fancy graphics; it's about pure, unadulterated, bone-crunching wrestling. Forge your legacy from the ground up. Create custom wrestlers, from hulking giants to rule-breaking villains, and assign them to powerful stables. Design your own championship belts and even build a unique moveset from a massive library of slams, submissions, and illegal maneuvers. Will you book a legendary Pay-Per-View card, survive the chaos of a 30-man Royal Rumble, or guide a chosen star through a grueling tournament to capture the gold? The choice is yours, but be warned: in the world of GRUNT, anything can happen. A botched move can lead to a career-ending injury, a heated rivalry can spill outside the ring, and sometimes, the referee just isn't paying attention. This isn't just a game; it's a sandbox for your wrestling stories. Build your dream roster, book the matches, and watch the chaos unfold! Run the Show Your Way! Book Epic Events: Schedule anything from a weekly fight night to a massive Pay-Per-View! Book matches manually to settle a score or let the system randomly generate a card for a night of surprises. Diverse Match Types: Settle rivalries in classic 1v1 bouts, prove who's the best in a grueling Tournament , or throw your entire roster into the ring for a chaotic Battle Royal or feel the excitement of a Royal Rumble ! Live the Drama: An in-depth simulation engine generates play-by-play commentary, tracks match momentum, and brings every bodyslam and signature move to life with color and sound effects! The Most Customizable Wrestling Sim EVER! This is where GRUNT WRESTLING truly shines. If you can dream it, you can create it. Forget pre-set limitations—build your federation from the ground up with unparalleled control. Create Your Own Federation: Start a brand-new promotion from scratch or launch a predefined roster to get right into the action. Manage multiple federations, each with its unique roster, champions, and history! Design Your Dream Wrestlers: Manually craft every single wrestler. Define their name, size (normal or a ring-shaking HUGE wrestler), and whether they compete under a mask. Assign them to stables and watch them climb the ranks. Build-A-Belt: Why settle for default titles? Design, name, and establish the prestige of your very own championship belts ! From the World Heavyweight Title to the Intergalactic Hardcore Television Championship, the gold is yours to create. Referees:   If you choose, six different referees will officiate the matches.  Each has their own 'Personalities' that can affect the outcome of the match.  Oh, and sometimes those referees are a little too slow and can be knocked out! Loaded Moves:   Choose a move to load up to deal out some extra damage!  But be careful, you could get caught and DQ'd by a sharp-eyed referee. The Ultimate Move Editor: This is a game-changer! Don't just pick from a list— create your own wrestling moves! Define a move's name, its damage, and a huge array of special properties. Tweak the Rules of Reality: Dig into the Game Criteria menu and become a true wrestling god. Adjust the injury system, set the health threshold for in-ring death, and even enable a 'Jail' or 'Death Penalty' system for wrestlers who take things too far! A Living, Breathing Universe Your federation evolves with every match. Wrestlers aren't just stats; they are characters with careers, rivalries, and legacies. Deep RPG System:  Your wrestlers earn XP, level up, and unlock powerful new skills and archetypes. Will you build a high-flying daredevil or a powerhouse brawler? Dynamic Rivalries: Wrestlers will form feuds that grow in intensity, adding extra heat and damage bonuses to their matches! Career-Altering Events: The action has consequences! Wrestlers can suffer injuries that put them on the shelf, force them into retirement, or even cause the death of an opponent.  Hey, this isn't 'entertainment' - it's the real deal!!! Track the Legacy: Follow every wrestler's journey with a detailed match history. Celebrate your champions with an in-depth chronological list of title reigns, complete with defense statistics. The Hall of Fame: Who is the greatest of all time? A detailed points system analyzes championships, win records, and career-defining moments to calculate a 'HOF Score.' Hold an annual ceremony to induct your most legendary performers into the Hall of Fame! Ready to build your wrestling empire? Download GRUNT - The Wrestling Game  and start booking the greatest federation the world has ever seen!
row.short_description: GRUNT - The Wrestling Game Step into the ring and take control! Welcome to GRUNT - The Wrestling Game, the ultimate text-based wrestling simulation! This isn't about fancy graphics; it's about playing in your own wrestling 'sandbox' and watching the chaos unfold!

row.name: Duck Dash
row.detailed_description: Duck Dash is a simple 2D platformer adventure game where you play as a duck named Scruffles. Features: Achievements 10 unique levels Duck Dash contains 10 unique levels with increasing difficulty and length (and their own easter eggs). Polished Player Movement Duck Duck has polished player movement that makes it fun to play whether you have never played a platformer game or if you are an experienced player. Duck Dash can be played at any pace, whether fast or slow. Speedrunning Mode Duck Dash contains a speedrunning mode so you can see the time it took for you to complete a level. Both local leaderboards and global leaderboards, so you can race other Steam users or local times. Ghosts are recorded for global leaderboards, so you can see your friends ghosts while racing them. Full Xbox Controller Support Duck Dash is fully playable with an Xbox controller. (Also, Scruffles is cute)
row.short_description: A fun and simple 2D platformer game about a duck named Scruffles. Fight your way through 10 levels with a smooth feeling movement system.

row.name: Eidolon: Fate of Fools
row.detailed_description: Eidolon: Fate of Fools is a mystical arena shooter inspired by Major Arcana tarot cards. Indulge your fate by collecting cards within the arenas and by looting defeated foes. Dominate the lobby by cleverly utilizing both the Upright and Inverted abilities of each card. Upright abilities often resemble traditional arena shooter weapons, while Inverted abilities can offer unique movement tech or provide a tactical edge: at the cost of discarding that card. Master these arcane powers as you fight to prove your divinity and achieve apotheosis. Fill any match with skilled bots or join your friends over LAN and Steam lobbies. Master 13 Major Arcana tarot cards each with two abilities: Upright and Inverted. Battle within 4 hand-crafted arenas or visit the firing range to hone your skills. Experience free-for-all with a twist: 2 legendary Power Weapons may alter your fate. Enjoy 11 minutes of epic menu music featuring themes for each of the Major Arcana. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: An arena shooter with a card game twist in which combatants compete using Major Arcana tarot cards. Celestials manifest in a metaphysical realm for a combat ritual that results in divinity... or death. Vanquish your foes to achieve apotheosis and the coveted prize of securing your fate.

row.name: Perfect Hue Arena
row.detailed_description: Play solo with up to 12 bots, or connect a controller to enable local multiplayer with a friend. 6 Game Modes Capture the Flag - Fight for a single flag and return it to the capture zone. Target Practice - Compete for the most target hits or play solo and hunt for a 5x hit combo. Pixel Pickup - Smash your opponent into pixels and rush to collect them all. Control Point - Reach the control points and secure them for 25 points each. Progress is faster in Hard difficulty. Orb - Hit the orb into the goal for 10 points. The next goal line respawns on the opposite side of the map. Boss - Defeat the boss by depleting their health meter with multiple stomps. They can evade attacks using a special teleport ability. Main Abilities Particle Scatter - Break into pixels to evade stomps. Puck - Throw a puck to stun your opponent; press down to drop. Slow Time - Go half speed at any time, with no limits. 6 Levels City Side - The home map with a simple and straightforward layout. Half city, half countryside. Castle - A quiet castle on the river, designed for flag fortification. Snowy Day - Cozy city suburb featuring a hockey rink mini-game. Rooftop - A busy street separates an expanding business district. Yacht - Ahoy! Battle on the deck of a moonlit yacht. Equip the scuba mask for a fast getaway. Moon Base - Explore the underground moon facility or float across the surface in low gravity. Two Player Mode Connect a controller and add a second player to the game.
row.short_description: A casual action platformer with 6 game modes including Capture the Flag, Boss, Pixel PIckup, and Orb. There are a variety of unique items to collect and atmospheric arenas to explore.

row.name: Prosrochennyy
row.detailed_description: Prosnocherryy Living inside your own head can feel easier. Until it doesn’t. Yuri doesn’t want to change the world. He doesn’t want to understand it either. He’s learned to survive in quiet routines, filled with gestures he doesn’t notice and days he barely remembers. He watches videos without watching them. Eats without hunger. Sleeps without rest. He doesn’t talk to anyone. He doesn’t do anything that hurts—but nothing that wakes him up, either. His body is just another container. He fills his stomach with whatever’s there, like ticking boxes on a list. Taste doesn’t matter. Just the motion. Just getting through the day. In his mind, life is something else: lighter, better, full of meaning. There, he can be whoever he wants. In reality, he’s just Yuri. And that’s enough... until it isn’t. Prosnocherryy is a story about living inward. About the noise no one hears. About disorders that hide and battles that go unnamed. There’s no lesson here. Just company. A visual novel game about dissociation, eating disorders and abandonment. You experience life through fragmented thoughts, simulating the inner voice of someone disconnected from reality. A text-based story of presence and absence.
row.short_description: A visual novel game about dissociation, eating disorders and abandonment. You experience life through fragmented thoughts, simulating the inner voice of someone disconnected from reality. A text-based story of presence and absence.

row.name: Greatest Angels
row.detailed_description: After a devastating breakup, Wyatt Lacey finds himself consumed by grief and self-loathing. One night, drawn by forces he doesn’t understand. He finds a sword on a trail near his house, and ends up wandering into a decaying asylum hidden deep in the woods. Inside its rusted halls, shadows take shape as monsters born from a mysterious force. and some friendly faces too, offering cryptic guidance, while some promise freedom through ruin. Wyatt must confront his past, navigate the labyrinth of his own despair, and decide if he will fight for healing… or surrender to hell. Psychological Horror in a Classic Style Greatest Angels is a compact, story-driven horror JRPG built to capture the unsettling pacing of classic psychological horror games. Featuring sprite-based exploration and haunting character encounters, it blends retro presentation with a modern, narrative-heavy design. Atmospheric Sound and Visuals While the asylum itself shifts in ways that defy sense. Nothing feels stable, as if the world is quietly unraveling around you. it can be harsh to look at or hear, or it can be beauty in every form through sight and sound. Surreal Environments Explore an asylum where every area carries symbolic meaning tied to Wyatt’s trauma. An Abandoned Jail, Makeshift Ritual Sights, A Hospital, and The Gardens underneath... Survival Horror Exploration & JRPG Combat Face grotesque monsters like Knife-body, Sorrow Eyes, and the wanderers The Burdened and The Siphoners. Collect limited items, solve puzzles, and fight using a simple but tense JRPG combat system, where each battle feels like a test of endurance and fear. Multiple Endings Your choices throughout the game shape Wyatt’s fate. Will he fight his despair & lose himself completely? Or grasp at a fragile new hope?
row.short_description: Take up the sword and escape from your old problems... Survive this abandoned asylum and you will bask in its answers... Confront entities that block your way, solve puzzles, and come to grips with your new reality in this Bite Sized Psychological Horror experience.
row.notes: Scenes in this game may depict mature topics such as suicide, mental illness, drug abuse.

row.name: Critters Breakout
row.detailed_description: Critters' Breakout is a chaotic and fun 3D chase adventure set across a variety of explorable maps. Experience the world from two different perspectives: play as one of the adorable Critters trying to escape, or take on the role of a ferocious Kollector determined to stop them. The Critters aren’t just running for fun — one wrong move and they’re puppy chow! To break free, they must search each map for useful items and build a secret gateway route to safety. Clever planning and quick thinking mean survival. Your goal as a Critter is to outsmart your pursuers and find a way to BREAKOUT! The Kollectors have one purpose: shut down any hope of escape and bring an end to the Critters’ Breakout once and for all. Track, chase, and use unique abilities to CAPTURE the Critters before they manage to flee. Along the journey, the Critters can rely on various friendly creatures to help them. The Mole Twins, the Filipino Tarsier, and others may lend a hand — feed them the right items and watch what happens. The experience shifts between exploration and heart-pounding chase sequences. Every Critter and Kollector has their own characteristics, special abilities, and powers, letting you choose how you want to play. Will you be the Hunter or the Hunted? This is Critters’ Breakout!!
row.short_description: Critters’ Breakout is a chaotic 3D chase adventure where you can play as the clever Critters escaping to freedom or as the fierce Kollectors trying to stop them. Scavenge items, outsmart enemies, and fight to survive. It is a Pinoy-made game that directly funds animal shelters when you play!

row.name: Crap Game, Don’t Play
row.detailed_description: A so-called “crap game,” a complete and utter piece of garbage, featuring but not limited to: Graphics so rough they hurt your eyes, with laughable cutscenes A broken, utterly useless user interface Mind-numbingly boring quests designed purely to waste your time Out-of-nowhere, meaningless old jokes Annoying, never-ending narration that won’t shut up A ridiculous story clumsily improvised by half-baked narrators Convinced yet? Ha! The joke’s on you. In reality, this game only manages to make a blocky character wander aimlessly across a blank map… and that’s it. Nothing more. Don’t expect anything else. Value your time, open your eyes, and stay far away from this trash. Do NOT play.
row.short_description: This is a true piece of junk. Every second you spend opening this game is a waste of your precious time. Your time is valuable—open your eyes and stay away from trash games.
row.notes: Includes some profanity and adult jokes.

row.name: YogLabs: Testing Initiative
row.detailed_description: Step into another dimension with YogLabs: Testing Initiative - where chaos brews and experiments never go as planned. You awaken as a freshly cloned copy of Honeydew, thrown into an unusual testing course of dangerous challenges. Can you survive the trials before disaster strikes and everything unravels? Hi everyone! My name is Sergio, and Elsewhere is a game I’ve been developing since 2012. Since late 2018, I’ve been working on it nearly full-time. All code for the game is done by me, while the art assets are either done by me or by my more talented artist friends. I’ve been a fan of the Yogscast for many years, and the core idea behind Elsewhere is to create a fully standalone game where players can embark on adventures reminiscent of classic Let’s Play series such as Jaffa Factory, Voltz, Moon Quest, and Hole Diggers, to name just a few. So here’s my fan-made YogLabs adventure! I built everything myself and I hope you enjoy playing through it as much as I enjoyed making it! I would love to be able to add new episodes to the game (the 2nd one is on its way) so please show your support by checking out Elsewhere! The game includes many references, jokes and secrets. Take your time and explore the lab. Features: ⛏️ Explore the facility as Honeydew and cause trouble as you go! 🎵 Notice some familiar guest voices to guide you through the puzzles 🐱 Play mini-games and find secrets - can you collect all the Jaffas? ❔ Complete the Testing Course and/or blow stuff up (optional) 🎁 YogLabs: Testing Initiative is a fan project and all Yogscast-related content is used with permission.
row.short_description: A unique puzzle-adventure set in the secret YogLabs research facility. As a newly created clone, you’ll face a series of challenges while disaster threatens to consume the laboratory.

row.name: Mystic Realms Playtest
row.detailed_description: <p>Master weapons, explore realms, and survive escalating challenges.</p><ul><li>Skill-based gunplay</li><li>Co-op up to 4 players</li><li>Meta progression</li></ul>

row.name: Frosten: Two Realms
row.detailed_description: The game will be released in episodes. The first episode is titled 'My Name Is Ivan'.   Currently, the second episode is in development. Ivan is an ordinary teenager with one extraordinary ability: as a child, he discovered he could freeze objects. He lives with his parents, who know nothing about his unique gift. The only person he’s shared this secret with is his best friend, Mel, who always supports him and helps him navigate life’s challenges. Frosten: Two Realms An exciting story about a young man named Ivan, who possesses the unique ability to freeze objects. His life takes a dramatic turn when he finds himself in a mysterious world filled with magic and danger. Alongside friends—both old and new—Ivan must uncover the secrets of his gift and find his way home. This visual novel game blends detective, adventure, and drama elements, inviting players to immerse themselves in a magical world and unravel its mysteries. A gripping plot with unexpected twists. Beautiful locations that bring your adventure to life. Characters whose emotions change based on dialogue choices. Unique sound effects recorded specifically for the game. Mini-games and puzzles to test your wits.
row.short_description: Frosten: Two Realms — An immersive story about a young man named Ivan, who possesses the extraordinary ability to freeze objects. His life takes a dramatic turn when he finds himself in a mysterious world brimming with magic and peril.

row.name: Bily'Sine
row.detailed_description: What is Bily'sine? Bily'Sine is an adventure game (2D, top view, pixel art) where you play as a human lost in a mysterious world populated by magicians forced to capture you! Explore the world of Bily'Sine, unlock its secrets and battle in magical duels to find your way back to the world of Humans ! Your choices will shape your destiny and that of the world of Bily'Sine, so... what are you going to do? Run away? Save it? Or perhaps... destroy it? A world to discover ! Bily'Sine is a magical world full of mystery, divided into 4 chapters. You'll meet some unique Hua characters through a series of dialogues with a choice of answers. The main story has several narrative paths depending on the actions you take during your adventure - it's up to you to find them! Secret stories can be unlocked if you're curious enough to explore every corner of Bily'Sine! Dynamic magic duels ! NO EXPERIENCE GAUGE, NO FARM, NO LEVEL! Absorb or dodge tons of magic projectiles, then attack! The duels are short but intense, so it's up to you to adapt: kill or neutralise your opponent! 'Save ? What do you means ?' NO POINT / SAVE FILE! You can load the game at any progress you like, as long as you've discovered the corresponding 'secret'. Secrets are words that allow you to resume the game at a specific time (from the secrets menu).
row.short_description: Once upon a time, there was a human lost in a magical world where fairy tales do not exist...

row.name: Heart Snatcher
row.detailed_description: One day you receive a text message, telling you of little treats you can earn, only if you complete a few simple tests. Inadvertently you sign away your heart, and things are more deadly than they seemed at first. Using all of the skills at your disposal, earn your freedom and some snacks along the way. Overcome fast-paced levels testing your limits: Heart Snatcher is a small game about overcoming a series of fast-paced movement-based challenges that require quick reflexes and perhaps retrying a few times. In addition to just dodging tiles, you may have to eliminate projectiles and solve other obstacles that come up over the course of your tests. Earn treats along the way: Your hard work and accomplishments aren't for nothing. Earn a variety of little treats throughout your escape and try to collect them all!
row.short_description: Survive the trials in this fast-paced, top-down action game as you dodge hazardous obstacles and eliminate projectiles to claim your promised reward.

row.name: Coin Pusher Simulator
row.detailed_description: Jingle and clatter——! This is your very own private coin pusher arcade! Game Introduction Coin Pusher Simulator is an immersive simulation game that perfectly recreates the experience of arcade coin pushers. What you hear is the crisp sound of coins colliding, what you see is a precarious mountain of prizes, and what you feel is the nervousness of sweating palms when making that crucial push! We have recreated the luster of every inch of metal, the trajectory of every coin, and even the slightly laggy retro joystick of the machine! But this is more than just a cold simulation——because you have a vibrant 'mascot girl' [Xiao Ji] accompanying you throughout! Play solo and enjoy the purest, stress-free fun of coin pushing! Drop a coin, awaken memories, and the story between you and 'Xiao Ji' begins now! row.name: Blackthorne's Manor

Your friend vanished after attending a party at the manor, and no one has seen them since. Armed with little more than your wits and a faintly glowing lantern, you step inside, not knowing what you'll find on the other side. Can you uncover the secrets of Blackthorne’s Manor, or will its mysteries remain locked forever? RISING TENSION Immerse yourself in the oppressive atmosphere of the manor, where every shadowed hallway and forgotten room hides a story. Interact with objects, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together the chilling history of Blackthorne’s family. Every discovery draws you deeper into the mystery, blending suspense and intrigue in a slow-burn horror experience. ESCAPING THE UNKNOWN Move through a semi-linear environment designed like a twisted escape room. Unlock doors, trigger mechanisms, and follow hidden clues to advance. Every puzzle solved reveals more of the manor’s story and brings you closer to finding your missing friend. FEATURES First-person exploration with environmental puzzle-solving. Creepy, atmospheric manor with a story woven into every room. Inventory-based interactions to manipulate the world and unlock new rooms. Lore fragments and hidden notes that reveal the manor’s dark past. Slow-burn suspense that escalates as you uncover the truth.
row.short_description: Blackthorne's Manor is a first-person mystery thriller, where logic, puzzles, and the supernatural collide. Search for your missing friend, uncover the secrets of Blackthorne Manor, and escape before the house claims you too.

row.name: Rage Quit
row.detailed_description: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Rage Quit is a first-person action game set in a liminal office tower trapped in the 90s. You’re the last human left, surrounded by robotic coworkers mimicking office life, gossiping, typing on outdated keyboards, all with eerie, too-perfect precision. Your world is this office, and it's begging to be destroyed, so grab your sledgehammer and let the chaos begin. The player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense, creating a unified gameplay identity. Its versatility allows light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks that shape the moment-to-moment action. There is no pause. Move, hit, dodge, keep the momentum flowing. Players must make fast, smart decisions under pressure. Combat constantly demands awareness, utilizing props creatively, flanking wisely, and timing your reflections precisely. Aggression is rewarded, but only when paired with tactical thinking. Everything you hit reacts, and everything you break makes you stronger. Props, walls, and enemies are all part of the toolkit. Use the office around you to create chaos: throw chairs, slide printers, or smash walls to gain the upper hand over the enemies.
