row.name: SPARTA 2035 Prologue
row.detailed_description: The free prologue to Sparta 2035 includes complete training in game mechanics and seven different missions showcasing the variety of content. We give players the opportunity to try out the most comprehensive version for free so they can make an informed decision about purchasing the full version. Sparta 2035  is a turn-based tactics & strategy game about a mercenary squad with an old-school action-movie vibe. Command an elite team of bold, stylish operators, wage a campaign in an alternative-future Africa, and decide the war’s outcome mission by mission. Be the commander. Calculate lines of fire, flank and break cover, and seize the high ground. Every turn is decided by your planning and honest physics—not by RNG. Hire fighters with personality. Combine classes—Assault, Specialist, Sniper, Machine Gunner, and Grenadier. Pick the right gear for the job, treat and extract, protect key operatives. Take calculated risks—high combat lethality makes every decision count. Between missions, run the base. Recruit, upgrade, purchase equipment, handle logistics, finances, medical, and downtime. Choose allied factions, build relationships, gather intel, and execute covert ops. Your choices have consequences—access to missions, gear, and allies changes because of what you do. Use tomorrow’s tools. Deploy drones, combat scanners, smoke, and optical camo. Upgrade and improve your kit to win under any conditions. Set the pace. Knock out a mission in 25–40 minutes or settle in for long sessions. Tune the challenge—go for a brutal tactical gauntlet or a light, relaxing run. What awaits you: No point-blank misses and no bogus randomness. Real ballistics, destructible cover, vertical gameplay, and cone overwatch. Mercenaries with character and mission-focused loadouts without busywork. Base management, contracts, budgets, allies—and consequences for your actions. Assemble the squad. Take the contract. Decide Africa’s future beyond 2035.
row.short_description: Turn-based tactics & strategy about an elite mercenary squad with an old-school action-movie vibe. Command Sparta: recruit distinctive fighters, upgrade your base, run missions, and decide Africa’s future—no point-blank misses, with real ballistics.

row.detailed_description: Trapped is a 2.5D scifi side scrolling platformer, where by a series of unfortunate events, you the player, have ended up inside a computer, where you need to find out how to escape the computer that you have been trapped inside of. Why are you here and what caused you to be in this position? Trapped takes inspiration from classic platformers, as well as other old games, when secrets weren't so easy to find in the games. Currently, there is only a jog, run, and jump. There are two types of collectables, coins, and gems. 100 coins will gain you an extra life, and each gem you collect will grant you an extra life. At the end of the game there is a high score, based on coins collected, gems collected, and lives lost. There are also counters to let you know how many you collected out of the total. There is currently no story in the game, that will come later. There is also currently no background music, I was working on some, but didn't feel the quality was good enough, so I pulled it. Current Background music is by Teknoaxe, and is called Love on a Starship - Remastered.

row.name: Incorporeal
row.detailed_description: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Incorporeal is a top-down isometric dungeon crawler where you can sever your soul from your body. Dash past traps, evade vengeful spirits, and send your spectral form to fight while having to defend your body. Solve puzzles and battle enemies to escape with the relics you seek, but only those who survive the catacombs can walk away with the treasure. Your body is exposed when your soul is unleashed, yet only through it can you battle foes. While your spectral form strikes at enemies by dashing through them, your fragile body remains vulnerable to traps and attacks. Success demands careful coordination; dodge incoming dangers, reposition your body, and time your soul’s actions precisely. Every encounter becomes a tense dance between offense and defense, forcing you to think on two fronts at once as fight to escape the catacombs alive. To succeed, you’ll need precision, cunning, and nerves of steel, balancing the fragile safety of your body with the power of your spectral soul. The relics are yours for the taking, but only if you can outsmart the dangers, overcome your enemies, and escape alive. Do you have what it takes to walk away with them?
row.short_description: Incorporeal is a dungeon crawler where you play as a treasure hunter who has the ability to sever their soul from their body. Dash through traps, strike foes with your spectral form, and protect your fragile body as you fight, puzzle, and survive the catacombs to claim ancient relics.

row.name: Conquering of the Royal Keep
row.detailed_description: Conquering of the Royal Keep is a decision driven, visual novel game in which the player takes on the persona of a squire of the Royal Guard, entering their final stage of training to become a full knight. However, there is more to the Royal Keep that meets the eye. As the squire makes their way through the trials and tribulations set forth by their last task, it is soon noticed that something about this keep is wrong, and the squire must face their death time and time again until they can finally conquer the mysteries of the Royal Keep.
row.short_description: Conquering of the Royal Keep is a choice-driven visual novel where a squire braves deadly trials, unravels dark mysteries, and endures each fatal loop until the secrets of the keep are finally conquered.

row.name: DigiME
row.detailed_description: Bring your avatar to life with DigiME—AI-powered motion capture, no suits or sensors required. Using just your webcam and mic, DigiME tracks upper-body, facial, and mouth movements in real time, instantly animating your character. Powered by NVIDIA RTX GPU acceleration and Intel NPU optimization via OpenVINO, DigiME delivers smooth, high-FPS performance while keeping system load low. Stream seamlessly to Twitch, YouTube, Discord, Zoom, and more—no expensive gear needed. For added convenience, the voice assistant MIA provides personalized hardware recommendations, helping you find the MSI products that best fit your streaming and content creation needs. Log in with your MSI Member account to unlock the full DigiME experience: create a personalized avatar with Ready Player Me, explore a wider range of preset avatars and virtual environments, and gain increased access to MSI’s AI-powered virtual assistant MIA.
row.short_description: DigiME is AI-powered livestreaming software that brings your virtual avatar to life using only a webcam and mic—no extra gear required. Instantly animate your character with real-time upper-body, facial, and mouth tracking, and stream seamlessly on Twitch, YouTube, Discord, Zoom, and more.

row.name: Ashes of the Forum
row.detailed_description: Overview: You are a spy in ancient Rome. On the night before a critical election, there is an assassination in the city. Your commander, Gaius Varianus, tasks you to find out who is behind the chaos. Gampleay and Mechanics: The game is a 3d first person visual novel limited to very simple mechanics: movement and interactions. Speak with other characters to learn more about the crime, and the person behind it. The final decision for who is responsible will be up to you to decide. Get it right and save the republic. Get it wrong and watch it burn. The game is non-replayable meaning that you have only one chance to get it right.
row.short_description: Ashes of the Forum is a 3d first person visual novel themed in ancient Rome with a polygon art style. You are a spy for a political faction and with turmoil in the city, you must find out who is ordering the assassination of top political figures, with simple interactions with NPCs to gather intel.

row.name: soundless - A MODERN SALEM IN REMOTE AREA -
row.detailed_description: milk+ visual's very first and most popular yuri title, soundless - A MODERN SALEM IN REMOTE AREA -, now makes its way to Steam! —Despite all the singing around her, her world was soundless. A small village cut off from the rest of the world, Phada, spends its days slowly, idling away time by speaking with one another, eating with one another, and dedicating their lives to holy scripture. With a population of only 145, the town is governed by the minuscule clergy known as the 'Group', which resides in the church on top of the hill. They worship a protective God comprised of two halves: 'Barrier' defensive energy and 'Expulsive' offensive energy. In such a tiny world where becoming a part of the social fabric is essential, young Mercy is denied this. From a young age she has seen the unseen, and she was taken in by the Group after losing her parents. Upon turning 10, her vision abruptly corrupted, causing panic among the villagers. It was decided by the Head Priest and the Holy Woman that the only way to deal with this curse was to aggressively apply the 'cure.' In other words, isolate Mercy until she stops seeing things. Now an empty shell of who she once was, 15 year old Mercy attends school and is constantly bullied by her classmates, some truly afraid of her, but most seeing her as an easy target. The sudden death of the 25th Holy Woman startles the village, causing many to believe Mercy's curse is spreading and for her abuse to become more aggressive. Then, one day, the Head Priest reveals God has given them two young Holy Women rather than one. When classes end the next day, one calls out to Mercy. 'I can see it, too.' Her parents died when she was eight, and she was taken in by the Group and now lives in the church. In order to cope with her poor treatment, she's cut herself off from any emotions. She believes it is her solemn duty to continue to endure the abuse, as she knows no other way of living. The New Holy Woman of the Barrier energy. Representing safety, tranquility, and a protective force, she's notably kind to Mercy, but that's only due to her God-given nature, or so it seems. The New Holy Woman of the Expulsive energy. She represents aggressive defense, the removal of toxins, and the force of annihilation. While she herself doesn't constantly abuse Mercy, she can get hostile with her words and prefers to stay away from her. The top student at the school in both academic and religious studies. She is aloof and dutiful. Her rigidness and above and beyond grades come from the fact that she is the only daughter of the Expulsive family, one of the two clergy families. A timid girl that's often seen clinging to Delilah. She will do anything Delilah asks of her. Because of a certain grudge, she treats Mercy cruelly when Delilah is not around. A boy who enjoys tormenting Mercy. He sees the village-wide abuse as an opportunity to vent his frustrations with the world around him. Known for being particularly disobedient compared to his peers. A nameless man who runs the Group and village with an iron fist. He is seemingly benevolent and once treated Mercy like his own daughter, but now stays distant. The 25th Holy Woman. Like the Holy Women before her, she takes on both halves of the God and acts as a channel for the energy and Its words. Over 80,000 words of good old cult horror toxic yuri in a linear (choiceless) narrative A retro interface and style of presentation, harking back to 2000s-era Japanese visual novels An option to choose between the original 2017 release artwork or the updated 2023 artwork An unlockable bonus epilogue story, crafted specially for the 5th anniversary Accessibility features such as photosensitive mode, screenshake disable, audio captions and image descriptions Ability to toggle the display of violent images
row.short_description: A yuri denpa tale about the cursed pariah of a rural cult, Mercy, and her fateful meeting with the Holy Maiden Auma. Bloody, bold, and bone-chilling, this visual novel explores the complexities of the cycle of abuse and the violence in playing by the rules.
row.notes: This game contains depictions of extreme bullying, religious and domestic abuse, cults, gore and torture, and disorienting and surreal scenes. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: Ghlobot Shift
row.detailed_description: In Ghlobot Shift, you’ll step into a glowing universe where the fate of the Ghlobots (Glowing Ghost Robots) rests on your hands. When the Demon King steals their Queen and scatters their stars across hidden dimensions, the Ghlobots’ only hope is to journey through seven dazzling universes and reclaim the power that fuels their ships. Each universe is alive with its own charm and challenge: soar through the shimmering skies of Starfield Falls, dive into the bright shores of Cascade Tides, brave the jagged landscapes of Basalt Barrens, and wander the mystical spores of Blightbloom Grove. Survive the icy winds of FrostBite Nebula, face the molten fury of Lavatide Cliffs, and descend into the haunting depths of Stellar Abyss. Every universe contains secret paths, glowing challenges, and hidden stars waiting to be uncovered. With 35 handcrafted levels and 7 unique boss battles, your adventure is filled with surprises at every turn. The hidden stars you collect aren’t just treasures — they are the lifeblood of the Ghlobots’ journey, empowering their ships and unlocking the way forward. Charming, colorful, and glowing with atmosphere, Ghlobot Shift invites you to explore, discover, and fight for the light of your people. Can you reclaim the stolen stars, free your Queen, and shift the balance back from darkness?
row.short_description: Ghlobot Shift is a charming space adventure where glowing little Ghlobots journey across 7 unique universes to reclaim their stolen stars and rescue their queen from the Demon King. Explore 35 handcrafted levels and face off against 7 epic bosses in glowing, otherworldly environments.

row.name: Pneuma
row.detailed_description: Pneuma is a single-player hack-and-slash adventure where you step into the role of Zoe, Deaths Apprentice stripped of her soul and left to fight for the pieces that were stolen from her. To reclaim what’s hers, Zoe must face off against the Seven Deadly Sins, each guarded by relentless hordes of skeletons, demons, and corrupted creatures determined to stop her at every turn. Every battle pushes Zoe closer to restoring her power and closer to the truth of her destiny: to rise again as the new embodiment of Death. Fast-paced combat, brutal enemies, and intense boss encounters will test your skill, timing, and strategy as you carve a path through a world drowned in darkness and corruption. KEY FEATURES Fast-Paced Hack-and-Slash Combat Slice through waves of enemies with fluid, responsive combat designed to feel rewarding and intense. Face the Seven Deadly Sins Each Sin serves as a unique, high-stakes boss encounter with its own mechanics, personality, and arena. Hordes of Skeletons & Demons Battle relentless enemies that force you to adapt, dodge, and choose your attacks wisely. A World Consumed by Darkness Explore corrupted city's and arenas, each themed around the Sins who rule them. Grow Stronger with Every Fight Collect the stolen fragments of Zoe’s soul to regain her power and uncover her true purpose. Stylish Abilities & Combat Variety  Unlock new moves, abilities, and strategies as you push deeper into the realm of the Sins. STORY SYNOPSIS Take Back What Was Stolen. Zoe’s soul has been shattered and claimed by the Seven Deadly Sins. To reclaim it, she must defeat each Sin, survive the hordes that defend them, and rise stronger after every battle. With each fragment recovered, Zoe steps closer to reclaiming her identity, and fulfilling a destiny tied directly to Death itself.
row.short_description: Take the role of Zoe, Deaths apprentice, and fight back against the 7 Deadly sins who stole the fragments of your soul, engage in fast paced top-down hack and slash action, fending off hoards of Hell's spawn. row.name: Otherworld Wandering Merchant
row.detailed_description: Key Gameplay Trade Between Worlds: Buy goods from the real world, then cross over to a fantasy realm to sell them to NPCs at a high markup. Understanding an item's rarity and an NPC's preferences is key to your success. A 30-Day Time Limit: You have exactly 30 days to play. Carefully plan your inventory for the next day's sales and execute an efficient trading strategy. You can only advance to the next day by sleeping, which also lets you receive your ordered packages. Your Mission: Your ultimate goal is to pay off the massive debt from a housing scam. The gold you earn in the fantasy world can be exchanged for real-world currency. First-Person View: Experience the fantasy and real worlds through a captivating first-person perspective. The stylized low-poly graphics will make you feel like a merchant on a unique journey. Features A Unique Economic System: Maximize your profit by balancing the purchase prices of goods in the real world, the selling prices in the fantasy world, and the exchange rate of currencies. Interact with Diverse NPCs: Chat with the colorful cast of NPCs in the other world. By understanding their tastes, you can sell your items for a higher price. As you trade with them, new items will appear in the village, creating more opportunities for you. A Relaxing and Strategic Experience: There is no combat or danger. The game is all about trading and strategy. This is the perfect game for players who enjoy a cozy experience that still challenges their minds.
row.short_description: Trapped by a massive ₩200,000,000 debt from a housing scam, you discover a mysterious portal to the otherworld. Your mission: buy goods in the real world, sell them for huge profits in the otherworld, and pay off your debt. You only have 30 days to earn it all back and start a new life!

row.name: Alchemy Hearts
row.detailed_description: In a decadent realm where magic and mischief rule, players take on the role of rogue alchemists competing in a twilight world known as the Lustrous Realm. Here, you are tasked with seducing, outsmarting, and defeating a lineup of dangerously enchanting anime girls—each a manifestation of a forgotten elemental goddess cursed by vanity and power. Armed only with a mystical deck of cards, players draw potions to heal, poisons to weaken, weapons to strike, and mana to chain devastating combos. Each target—whether it’s the Crimson Geisha, the Abyssal Bunny Queen, or the Egyption Feline—has unique abilities and tempting tricks to turn the battle in her favor. Every victory breaks a piece of the curse binding these femme fatales, revealing glimpses of their tragic backstories and granting players access to rare cards and steamy secrets. But be warned: the deeper you go, the more seductive and deadly your targets become. Will you master the deck and conquer the Lustrous Realm—or fall victim to beauty, deceit, and arcane vengeance? 70 plus cards Intriguing story with captivating visuals

row.name: Cooking Time!
row.detailed_description: Players can collect kitchen cookware and install them into their kitchen, once that is done, players can collect ingredients and cook them in their installed cookware. Each ingredient and cooking way adds a special ability to your final dish that you can throw at yourself or your enemies. To join a game, one player must press the host button, and the other player has to enter the given room code to join the host's lobby.  Once joined, the players can collect ingredients and/or cookware that falls from the top  of their screen. Once they collect any cookware they can then approach their kitchen and hold 'E' to install it into their kitchen. Once the players gather an ingredient, they can cook it using the cookware they have installed. Each ingredient gives the players unique powers. For example:  Chillies deal fire damage each second that goes through the enemy's defence. Tomatoes heal the player they hit. Mushrooms boost the strength of the player they hit. There are lots of different maps that players can combat in, which include moving and rotating platforms.

row.detailed_description: 我们想打造一种很不一样的塔防游戏， 它应该很紧张，很刺激，除了策略， 还应该有英雄操控，玩起来更像我们过去玩的魔兽RPG, 很大很多花样不同的地图, 潮水一样无数的怪。。。还能多人合作。 对了！ 玩家之间还要能够公平竞技来一场PK, 这种PK要比MOBA游戏轻度一点， 可以1对1， 但比皇室战争要复杂，塔的选择，出兵的相克和时机把握， 英雄的操控这三种元素都应该很重要。。。嗯。。。于是有了现在的《策马守天关》！！！欢迎来体验！ 游戏最新玩法中加入了很多自由建造以及游戏局内的rouge-like式的随机战术技能选卡等元素， 变成了和moba游戏类似的一个比较长的局内养成，每次养成方向和随机发挥的不同， 让每一局的感受都会大不一样， 围绕这个核心的新玩法，我们有单人挑战的《群英阁》，双人合作的《人族无敌》等娱乐地图，玩家通关了最初的2个战役章节熟悉了基本操作之后就会解锁上述玩法， 非常推荐大家来体验！！！ 另外，其实我们的塔防游戏里，一直有些玩法和模块没有交待给玩家， 就仿佛shake shack和星巴克的隐形菜单一样的存在, 资深吃货心知肚明， 新人则毫无知觉。比如英雄等级上限，如果玩家不去我们的一对一的moba竞技场被虐待一圈， 就不会发现英雄的升星原来藏在这里。又比如三国英雄们，实际上背后是区分了青龙，白虎，朱雀，玄武四个分类， 但如果没有玩到把装备隐藏的圣兽觉醒给点亮的程度，玩家就不会知道这些系列分类的存在， 它们的世俗意义就是：青龙其实是法术战士，白虎是敏捷战士和敏捷法师，朱雀是纯正法师，玄武是坦克。 那么围绕游戏最后开放的新七章节， 隐藏菜单被拿出来进一步强化了：新增英雄进驻塔位的玩法。自古以来我们游戏和别人的塔防不一样的就是极其依赖操作，号称策略与操作并重（不想提数值也并重，免得被玩家打。。。），手忙脚乱的指挥英雄们四处串场救火， 是我们玩法的一个基础设定。但是往往一张地图，无影手级别的玩家操作极限也就是3只英雄同时操控。。。，那。。我们推出了新的可被英雄进驻的塔位， 英雄进驻后，会根据自己青龙白虎朱雀玄武特质，获得对应的属性加成。从而变身为超强塔， 如何搭配他们才能通关，就变成了新的策略所在，也满足了无影手玩家内心渴望的挂机休闲的放松一刻（其实英雄大招还是要择机释放的，搞不好无影手玩家被逼成了超强无影手，对此我们也不想负责。。。） 下面是一些游戏的基本介绍文字，就这么看看吧！ 我们想自封一个三国塔防巅峰之作!， 因为这么硬核重度又考验操作的塔防手游确实不多见， 我们也就这么一条路走到黑了！ 游戏延续策马三国写实风格的经典英雄人物和游戏场景，目前七个大章节总计70余个精心设计的剧情关卡，出场26位脍炙人口的三国英豪, 带您踏入汉末乱世，让人耳目一新的体验全新的热血三国塔防游戏，每位英雄在塔防战场上都有自己的独特定位和独有技能，您可以控制他们主动出击，施放强力技能，与防御塔配合，消灭大波敌军。每一个关卡都需要您开动脑筋，利用各类防御塔、英雄卡以及战术技能卡的组合，阻击一波又一波敌兵。敌军首领拥有各种技能，更是增添了游戏的惊险刺激。BOSS、陷阱、救援、发兵、偷袭，对攻! 每分每秒都在挑战您的策略和操作。 竞技方面，我们内置了一个小型moba的塔防对抗游戏【玩家1 VS 1对抗地图 : 夺塔奇兵】 5 ～ 10分钟一局的激烈战斗，以手动发兵环环相克的策略融合了塔防的华丽防守与moba游戏的围猎刺激！ 除此之外， 游戏中内置了大量的娱乐地图板块， 比如 故事包《吕布传》：英雄美女再续前缘，地牢模式，阵营互推。 《铜雀台》模拟街机感受， 机关重重， 5位英雄车轮闯关暗黑地下城。 多人合作无尽模式 《 魔龙宝库》， 使用摇杆模式指挥英雄动作闯关的《黄月英传》 双人配合的魔兽rpg塔防的经典模式《人族无敌》。。。简直道不尽，说不完， 基本上。。。塔防被我们玩坏了！ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 您在游戏中遇到任何问题，请加入我们的QQ官方服务群：633206085，管理员将协助您解决！

row.name: Apples in the Abyss
row.detailed_description: A puzzle platformer passion project where you manipulate the fabric of space to collect some apples. Tear holes, rotate chunks, and mirror entire columns of space across each other. Collect all the apples with a given set of abilities in each stage. Ability 1: The hole Tear a square hole in space with a specified direction, deleting everything inside, terrain included. Afterwards, everything in the column given by the direction specified is pulled into the vacuum. This imparts momentum to the player Ability 2: The rotation Rotate a square chunk of space to any angle you wish. Rotating yourself changes your direction of gravity.  Ability 3: The mirror Select a reflection line and a direction. Space is reflected across that reflection line. All abilities work with physics, so you can rotate yourself and maintain the same momentum in your reference frame.  100% Full refund guaranteed if you find any bugs. No questions asked

row.name: WhoIs
row.detailed_description: IDENTIFY. EXECUTE. ESCAPE. Welcome to a first-person PvP deathmatch where paranoia is your closest companion. At the start of each round, you are secretly assigned a role and a target. Your goal is simple: find them, eliminate them, and reach an escape way before the other players complete their own grim assignments. The arena is a procedurally generated sci-fi labyrinth—a new puzzle of corridors and kill-zones every time. You must use your role’s unique abilities to gain an edge, but power comes at a price. Every action risks exposing your identity to those who are hunting you. Do you strike now and risk it all, or do you wait in the shadows, hoping your target makes the first mistake? Every nearby whisper and panicked shout matters. Forge a temporary truce to take down a common threat, or lure an unsuspecting player into a trap with a lie. Only three escape ways will open for the victors. They cannot be reused. Once they are gone, so is your chance. The roles have been decided. The objective is constant. Escape. FEATURES Trust No One: A 4-8 player social deduction shooter where everyone is a potential killer. Procedural Sci-Fi Arenas: A new layout every match—fresh routes, fresh traps, fresh mistakes. Secret Roles, Asymmetric Goals: Each role points you toward specific enemies you must find and eliminate to fulfill your mission. Risky Powers: Abilities help you hunt or survive, but using them—or finishing someone—can reveal your identity. Escape to Win: After completing your mission, reach an exit to claim victory. Exits are single-use and there are at most three on the arena. Proximity Voice Chat: Lies and alliances work best when whispered within arm’s reach. How a Match Unfolds Drop In: 4–8 players spawn across a 3D, procedurally generated sci-fi complex. Receive a Role: Your assignment includes a special power and the kind of opponent you’re meant to find. Blend or Hunt: Gather intel, follow tells, and watch for slips. Keep your role hidden to avoid being hunted yourself. Commit or Conceal: Use your ability or strike—but know that these high-risk actions can expose you. Finish the Job: Complete your mission, then escape through a single-use exit (up to three exist per arena). Leave nothing but confusion behind.
row.short_description: A 4-8 player PvP game of deception and paranoia. You have a role, a target, and one mission: eliminate them and escape. Use powerful abilities at the risk of revealing your identity. In this ever-changing arena, hunt or be hunted.

row.name: Irian: City of ruin
row.detailed_description: Game Controls WASD - Move Q - Heal Space - Dodge Left Click - Normal Attack Right Click - Special Attack Mouse Movement - Rotate View Basic Gameplay 'Dodge'(Space) enemy attacks, defeat them, and collect the dungeon gauge. When the dungeon gauge reaches 100%, a boss will appear, and defeating the boss will end the stage. Successfully dodging enemies will slow down time, allowing you to unleash a 'counterattack'. Defeat enemies with a certain chance to receive a healing item. Collecting five allows you to use 'Recovery' (Q). Game Description   A 3D action game in a roguelike format. Set various skills and enhance them. Story summary   The city of Irian, known as the City of Endless Light, thrived on the mysterious energy radiating from the Aether Core. But the power flowing from the Rifts slowly began to consume the city. Strange disappearances and eerie incidents spread across its outskirts, until a massive Rift swallowed part of the city and unleashed terrifying creatures. Conventional weapons proved useless, and the war turned hopeless as Irian's light began to fade.   Amidst the chaos, a girl named Saeryeon awakens in the ruins, her memories lost. Within her flows a strange energy connected to the Rift itself, granting her the instinctive power to slay the monsters. She is not just a survivor—she is the one destined to control the Rift.   To save both the city and herself, Saeryeon must venture into the heart of the Rift. Her choices and sacrifices will uncover the source of Irian’s darkness and force her to confront the past she has lost. Skill Swap   Attempting a strong attack during normal attacks 1-4 will activate a special skill. Players can freely swap the positions of various special skills to create their preferred combat style. Constant challenge   Defeat constantly appearing enemies and defeat bosses to continue progressing through the stages. Each time you clear a stage, you'll receive a reward buff. Become stronger and climb higher. Stage Challenge Content:   Challenge your limits. Each stage presents a random challenge. Failure is fine, but success grants additional rewards. Timebound Curse: Clear the next battle within 2 minutes to earn an extra [Ability Boost] reward. Evasion Curse: Clear the next battle while taking fewer than 5 hits to earn an extra [Ability Boost] reward. Destruction Curse: Enemy Attack Power increases by 20% in the next battle. Clear the stage to gain +10% Attack Power. Stone Skin Curse: Enemy HP increases by 20% in the next battle. Clear the stage to gain +10% Max HP. Proliferation Curse Enemy spawn count doubles in the next battle. Defeating enemies grants 200% more Ether Seeds.
row.short_description: A 3D roguelike action game where you set and enhance skills. In the collapsing city of Irian, Saeryeon awakens with Rift-born powers. Fight endless enemies, defeat bosses, and uncover the city’s hidden darkness.

row.detailed_description: Contact us Discord: [cheryl7773] Facebook: [AnimeGirlsFB] WhatsApp: [+852 6158 0053] X: [AnimeGirlsEN] About the Game Embark on a legendary journey where 100+ goddesses from different races await your command! Welcome to a world where strategy, collection, and creativity define your journey. 🎙️ Renowned Voice Acting Top Japanese voice actors, including Nana Inoue and Kana Yuki, bring every goddess to life. Enjoy personalized voice lines and dynamic Live2D animations for a truly immersive experience. 📖 Deep Storylines Follow the epic main story and uncover each goddess’s personal journey. Unlock invitation and trial stories to explore their pasts and the lore of this world. ⚔️ Master Tactical Battles Engage in 6v6 battles on a strategic 2×3 grid: • Position your goddesses carefully to protect allies and defeat enemies. • Combine skills and abilities to unleash powerful team bonuses. • Execute spectacular special moves with stunning visual effects. 💎 Player-First Economy Transparent gacha system with high SSR rates. Our community is diverse and welcoming, with players from every corner of the world. Developer’s Letter Dear Commanders, Welcome to Goddess of Fate , a project born from our team’s love for strategic RPGs and heartfelt storytelling. From the very beginning, our goal has been simple: to create a world where tactical depth meets emotional connection. Every goddess you encounter was crafted with care—designed, animated, and voiced to feel truly alive. We’re honored to have partnered with talented Japanese voice actors such as Nana Inoue and Kana Yuki , whose performances breathe soul into each character, sometimes fierce, sometimes gentle, but always full of heart. Combat in Goddess of Fate rewards smart strategy over raw power. Victory isn’t about having the rarest cards; it’s about how you use them—mastering formations, exploiting synergies, and seizing the right moment to strike. Most importantly, we wanted to create a game that respects your time . All main content, including the full story, is fully playable without spending a single cent. Optional purchases exist only for those who wish to enhance their experience, never to gate progress. Your success depends on your strategy, creativity, and perseverance, not on spending. We’re deeply grateful to have you with us on this journey. We can’t wait to see the teams you build, the tactics you master, and the stories you’ll share along the way. Thank you for playing, and welcome to the world of Goddess of Fate . The Goddess of Fate Team ✨ The idea for Goddess of Fate was born from our team’s shared love for anime, mythology, and strategic gaming. We were inspired by the rich tapestry of global mythologies, where gods and goddesses embody the essence of human emotions, aspirations, and conflicts. magic,hellcard,manor,yakuza,marvel,mage,wallpaper,lego,redsec,hogwarts,refate,victoria,shogun,blue,archive, diablo,atelier,repo,pretty,derby,sims,kingdom,moe,cute,fantasy,kawaii,gacha,cosplay,otaku,manga,tale,tales,nba,ea, human,siege,RV,peak,dcs,gof,cod,battlefield,tes,tfd,fortnite,fc26,mecha,stellar,blade,wuthering,waves,chaos,child, avatar,rust,2024,f1,Microsoft,summer,strategy,casual,synergy,astral,2k26,digimon,winter,snowbreak,genshin,honkai, marvel,turn-based,warhammer,team,building,final,fantasy, persona,dragon,palworld,black,myth,ninja4,marvel,rivals,wukong,escape,megabonk,mhw,Nikki,rdr,hoi,ets,dbd,diablo,banana,red,dead,4,2,football,manager,26,delta,riders,force,efootball,wuchang,exilium,frontline,reverse,apex,2077,gta, baldur,lords,jurassic,cities,kings,clair,crusader,black,fallout,pubg,dota,cs,cs2,hades,naraka,bloons,world,king,disney,stellaris,ecchi,duckov,dayz,911,crysis,forza,lol,lottery,europa,fungeon,arc,raiders,bf,bf6,hentai,fgo,lolita,loli,bilibili,. From the fiery determination of a war goddess to the serene wisdom of a celestial deity, we wanted to bring these archetypes to life as unique, relatable characters—waifus with depth, personality, and stories that resonate. Our vision was clear: create a game that celebrates the diversity of these goddesses while offering players a chance to form meaningful connections with them through gameplay and narrative. Anime has always been a medium that transcends borders, blending stunning visuals with compelling storytelling. We wanted Goddess of Fate to capture that magic, combining the charm of anime-style characters with the strategic depth of card-based RPGs. But we didn’t stop there. We sought to push boundaries by integrating dynamic Live2D visuals, a robust affinity system, and a tactical combat framework that rewards creativity and planning. Our mission was to craft an experience that feels alive, where every goddess is more than a card—she’s a companion on your legendary journey. Crafting the Goddesses: Art, Voice, and Soul At the heart of Goddess of Fate are its 100+ goddesses, each a unique blend of mythology and anime flair. From the outset, we knew that the characters would be the soul of the game. Our art team worked tirelessly to bring these goddesses to life using Live2D technology, which allows for fluid, dynamic animations that make every character feel vibrant and responsive. Whether it’s the flutter of a goddess’s hair in the wind or the subtle shift in her expression during a heartfelt moment, these details create a sense of intimacy and immersion. For special goddesses, we introduced interactive touch reaction skins, allowing players to engage with their favorite characters in a playful, personalized way. Sound design was equally critical. We partnered with renowned Japanese voice actors, including talents like 井ノ上奈々 and 優木かな, to give each goddess a distinct voice that reflects her personality. From the commanding tone of a warrior goddess to the soft, teasing lilt of a mischievous spirit, every line was recorded to enhance the emotional depth of the characters. The voice library, unlocked through our dating-sim-style affinity system, lets players discover new dialogue as they build relationships with their goddesses. This system isn’t just a feature—it’s a way to make every interaction feel personal, as if these characters are truly growing alongside you. A World of Stories: Epic and Intimate The narrative of Goddess of Fate is designed to be both grand and personal. The main storyline follows your journey as a summoner tasked with uniting the goddesses to restore balance to a fractured world. This epic tale is filled with twists, betrayals, and moments of triumph, drawing inspiration from classic anime tropes and mythological sagas. But what sets our story apart is its depth and variety. Beyond the main plot, each goddess has her own “invitation story,” a personal narrative that delves into her origins, dreams, and struggles. These stories are unlocked through gameplay and affinity progression, offering players a chance to connect with their favorite characters on a deeper level. Additionally, we introduced “trial stories” that challenge players to uncover hidden lore and earn exclusive rewards. These bite-sized narratives add layers to the game’s universe, revealing the interconnected fates of the goddesses and the world they inhabit. Whether it’s a tale of a celestial goddess’s sacrifice or a mischievous fox spirit’s redemption, these stories are crafted to evoke emotion and spark curiosity. Our writers worked closely with cultural consultants to ensure that the mythological inspirations—spanning Eastern and Western traditions—are respectful and authentic, while still infused with the playful energy of anime storytelling. Tactical Combat: Strategy Meets Spectacle Combat in Goddess of Fate is where strategy and spectacle collide. Our 6v6 tactical battle system is built around a 2×3 grid, where positioning is as critical as team composition. Placing a goddess in the front row might maximize her offensive potential but expose her to greater risk, while a back-row placement could enhance her support abilities but limit her impact. This system demands careful planning, as every decision—from unit placement to skill selection—can turn the tide of battle. To deepen the strategic experience, we designed a robust synergy system that rewards creative team-building. Mixing and matching goddesses from different races—such as celestial, demonic, or elemental—unlocks exclusive team effects that enhance performance. For example, pairing a fire goddess with a wind spirit might trigger a “Blazing Tempest” synergy, boosting attack speed and critical damage. These synergies encourage experimentation, ensuring that no two players’ squads feel the same. Add to this our dynamic skill combos and flashy special effects, and every battle becomes a visual and tactical feast. Player-First Philosophy: Accessibility and Fairness One of our core principles is ensuring that Goddess of Fate is welcoming to all players, regardless of whether they choose to spend money. We’ve designed a player-first economy that prioritizes accessibility and fairness. Our gacha system is transparent, with high SSR rates and guaranteed banners to give players a fair shot at their favorite goddesses. In-game events offer ample opportunities to earn free base characters, making it easy for collectors to build their dream roster without breaking the bank. Most importantly, there are no paywalls—every piece of story content and PvP reward is fully accessible to free-to-play players. This approach has resonated with our community, as evidenced by our 92% 7-day retention rate, far surpassing the industry average of 62%. We’re also proud to have a 25% female player base, the highest in the strategic card game genre, reflecting our commitment to creating a game that appeals to a diverse audience.These numbers aren’t just stats—they’re a testament to the trust and enthusiasm our players have shown us, and we’re dedicated to maintaining that trust through ongoing updates and fair practices. A Global Experience: Cross-Platform and Localization We designed Goddess of Fate to be a truly global game. With seamless cross-platform support, players can sync their progress between mobile and PC, enjoying buttery-smooth gameplay at up to 140 FPS on desktop. This flexibility ensures that whether you’re on the go or at home, your journey with the goddesses is always within reach. Our localization team worked diligently to create a Western-friendly UI and design, ensuring that cultural nuances are preserved while making the game accessible to players worldwide. From intuitive menus to clear tutorials, we’ve strived to make Goddess of Fate a welcoming experience for both seasoned anime fans and newcomers. Our Commitment: Building a Community with You Creating Goddess of Fate has been a labor of love, but we know that a game’s true potential is realized through its community. We’re committed to listening to your feedback, whether it’s about balancing combat, adding new goddesses, or refining story content. Our roadmap includes regular updates with fresh characters, events, and story arcs, ensuring that the game evolves alongside our players. We’ve already seen the incredible creativity of our community, from fan art of the goddesses to strategic guides shared on social platforms like X. Your passion inspires us, and we can’t wait to see how you shape this world. We also want to foster an inclusive community where players of all backgrounds feel valued. Whether you’re a collector chasing every goddess, a tactician dominating PvP, or a story enthusiast diving into the lore, Goddess of Fate is your game. Join our official community channels to share your strategies, favorite moments, or even suggestions for new goddesses—we’re all ears! Looking Ahead: A Legendary Journey Continues As we look to the future, we’re excited to expand the world of Goddess of Fate. New goddesses, cross-over events, and deeper storylines are already in the works, alongside quality-of-life improvements based on player feedback. We’re exploring ways to enhance the affinity system, perhaps by adding new interaction mechanics or exclusive rewards for maxed-out relationships. We’re also considering seasonal PvP leagues and global tournaments to give competitive players a chance to shine. Final Words: Your Adventure Awaits Goddess of Fate: Waifus RPG is more than a game—it’s a celebration of anime, mythology, and the bonds that unite us. With 100+ goddesses, dynamic Live2D visuals, tactical combat, and a player-first economy, we’ve crafted a world where every player can find their place. Whether you’re drawn to the strategic depth, the emotional stories, or the sheer joy of collecting waifus, we hope Goddess of Fate becomes a journey you cherish. Thank you for joining us on this legendary adventure. Let’s summon the goddesses, forge unbreakable bonds, and write a saga that echoes across the ages!

row.name: The land of Norverenda
row.detailed_description: Once, a sacred well sustained Ravy’s hometown with endless blessings. But one day, the well mysteriously ran dry. The land withered, prayers went unanswered, and hope began to fade. Refusing to wait for miracles, Ravy chose to set out on a journey—seeking the legendary land of Norveranda , where the source of blessings is said to lie. This game is a narrative-driven adventure about exploration, gentle encounters, and the search for hope. As you guide Ravy through unfamiliar lands, you’ll uncover secrets, meet kindred spirits, and piece together the story of a world once touched by light. A gentle yet mysterious story about farewell, pursuit, and homecoming . Journey through warm forests, misty swamps, and more , with new discoveries on every map. Meet NPCs, collect items, and unlock interactions —your choices shape Ravy’s path. Gather scattered pearls and memory fragments to uncover the secret of Norveranda. A delicate hand-drawn art style combined with soft, soothing music creates a warm and healing adventure.
row.short_description: Ravy embarks on a heartfelt journey to Norveranda, a land only spoken of in legends. Guided by blessings and cherished memories, he must face trials, gather precious fragments of his past, and restore hope to his fading hometown.

row.detailed_description: Immersive Campus Exploration : There's no gameplay, no objectives — just a slow, nostalgic journey. Choose to stroll or glide through the campus from third-person or free-flying perspectives at your leisure. A Memory Reborn : While inspired by our beloved alma mater, every scene and building is an artistic reinterpretation — not a literal replica, but a digital tribute crafted from memory and creativity. A Gentle Invitation : Designed for anyone who cherishes their school days — this experience offers a sensory and emotional embrace that feels like home. Disclaimer This project was developed by a student-led group of enthusiasts during their free time, and is not an official product. Inspired by our beloved campus, this work uses artistically reimagined scenes and architecture, not exact replicas, and is not affiliated with any educational institution. Should any copyright concerns arise, please contact us for resolution.
row.short_description: Virtual ABC Journey is a virtual campus simulation experience. Wander effortlessly through a beautifully art-styled school and immerse yourself in warm memories and a nostalgic atmosphere. This emotional journey revives your campus—not just in photos or memory, but as a living digital space.

row.name: Tarah طاره
row.detailed_description: “Tarah” is a slang term refers to professional driver. Gear up for “Tarah”, the ultimate PC racing playground ! from desert to city streets,day and night, players can race solo races or online battles. With tons of cars to unlock that match culture famous cars, you can customize them with endless parts and upgrades. Play with friends online on multiple fields with your favourite customized cars
row.short_description: 'Tarah' is the ultimate PC racing playground! Race solo or online across deserts and city streets, day or night. Unlock and customize cars inspired by cultural icons with endless parts and upgrades, then take on friends in thrilling multiplayer battles.

row.name: Death in a Party - ACT I
row.detailed_description: You can't believe it's still there. The remains of Mannyland. That 90's theme park based on the popular character franchise 'Manny and Friends'. Somehow, knowing this fills you with a sinking feeling. The call of unresolved memories pull you back... And now you have the key. EXPLORE and DISCOVER this psychological horror comedy inspired by janky point and click games of days gone by, the works of David Lynch and Toby Fox, plus a certain pink yellow blob-themed British pop-culture character. Imagine if that house party never ended... It continued, in secret, with what we weren't supposed to see. There are no monsters here. Only people. FEATURES: Over 200 hand-drawn 2D backgrounds, 3D Environments with a hand-drawn style, Things to click on, 0% monster chase scenes!!, Reluctant jump scares, Pain and Suffering :( AAA Game (There's three A's in the title), Highly specific humour based on 1990's British life,  Features the Toxic Best Friend Simulator , Made by one person!
row.short_description: You begin in a theme park forgotten to the world for over a decade. What you uncover will take you further down, below the surface, to man-made horrors you can comprehend. Point and click horror game about nostalgia.
row.notes: This game contains themes of a mature nature that may be triggering. TRIGGER WARNINGS: Graphic descriptions of physical injuries to adults and children. Psychological horror, emotional abuse and trauma, mental illness, self harm and suicide. Crude language. References to alcohol and alcohol abuse. Contains flashing imagery.

row.name: Perfore la demande du perforien Playtest
Arithmetic Arena
row.detailed_description: Sharpen your mind, climb to the top of the ranks, and prove your skill on the global stage. In this arena, there is no luck—only skill. Arithmetic Arena is a competitive math-challenge game built on the ELO ranking system . Each challenge tests not only your speed and accuracy, but also your ability to stay calm and composed. Confidence and composure will let you truly enjoy the game and find fun in every challenge. ELO & Ranking System: Completing challenges changes your ELO score, which reflects your current skill level in real time. Rise from beginner all the way to Master and beyond. As you climb, the difficulty increases sharply—keeping your brain constantly challenged. Global & Friend Leaderboards: Track your rank in real time, challenge your friends, and compete with players from all around the world. Endless Challenge: Whether you want a quick test or a long grind through the ranks, the arena dynamically adjusts difficulty based on your performance, ensuring the experience stays rewarding. Instant Action: The game is highly optimized, allowing you to load, enter, and start a challenge in the shortest time possible—while staying light on system resources when running in the background. Standard Challenge Mode: When you choose to begin, you’ll receive a single challenge tailored to your current ELO rating. Once you submit your answer, your ELO score will be adjusted based on the result. You can decide when to start your next challenge at any time. Multiplayer Competitive Mode (Coming Soon): Party up with friends or let matchmaking pair you with players of similar skill. You’ll be paired with players whose ELO ratings are close to yours, competing in 1v1 or 2v2 battles. Challenge difficulty is determined by the average ELO of both teams. When a player submits an answer, their team will instantly see the result. If the challenge fails, the victory goes to the opposing team. The first team to secure 15 wins claims overall victory. Multiplayer Co-op Mode (Coming Soon): Team up with friends or queue solo to be matched with players of similar ELO ratings. Groups of 2–4 players will work together to complete 25 challenges based on the team’s average ELO. Once a player submits an answer, the result is shown immediately and the team moves on to the next challenge. Final ELO adjustments are calculated from both team performance and individual contributions. Rank & Leaderboard Rewards:  Your rank is a reflection of your skill and experience. At the end of each season, exclusive badges and item rewards will be granted based on your final rank — a unique memento of that season. Players who reach the top of the leaderboard will also receive additional rewards according to their final standings.
row.short_description: Arithmetic Arena is a competitive math-challenge game built on the ELO ranking system. Each challenge tests not only your speed and accuracy, but also your ability to stay calm and composed. Confidence and composure will let you truly enjoy the game and find fun in every challenge.

row.name: Hurricane Heroes
row.detailed_description: Hurricane Heroes is a 3-act interactive narrative experience that places players in the shoes of three critical roles as a storm approaches and impacts the coast of Florida. Act 1: Broadcast meteorologist convincing viewers to evacuate before a hurricane hits Act 2: Weather science officer collecting valuable data from inside the storm Act 3: Emergency rescue support in the wake of the hurricane’s destruction The game is designed for Introduction to Meteorology students and aligns with course materials, but it can be played by anyone interested in learning more about hurricanes and careers related to meteorology. Some creative liberties taken.
row.short_description: Hurricane Heroes is a 3-act interactive narrative experience that places players in the shoes of three critical roles as a storm approaches and impacts the coast of Florida.

row.name: LUCIFERIANISM
row.detailed_description: “Go on, halt-foot,” cried his frightful voice, “go on, lazy-bones, interloper, sallow-face!—lest I tickle thee with my heel! What dost thou here between the towers? In the tower is the place for thee, thou shouldst be locked up; to one better than thyself thou blockest the way!” -Friedrich Nietzsche, Thus Spoke Zarathustra, The Parable of the Rope Dancer LUCIFERIANISM is an indie roguelike soulslike. Set in a labyrinthine maze of 290 levels, it is an open world game, an rpg that will take you to a multitude of different locations, from Ancient Chinese and Japanese inspired levels, to modern day Urban Environments, and Cyberpunk Dystopia's. Made by one man in Unreal Engine 5, I have attempted to create a serious religious story with this work, which I somewhat succeeded at. It is an allegory, a religious parable, and a philosophical commentary on Nietzsche's Death of God. The player can also press a button to start reading out philosophy, literature, and religious writings, from a variety of sources, including Plato, Nietzsche, Bram Stoker, Don Quixote, The Tao Te Ching, Freud, Shakespeare, Homer, Journey to the West, and various other works from literary history. Plus a shutup button. Almost 300 Levels in a Gigantic Open World Fully Voiced Dialogue by Elevenlabs AI Voice Robots 30 GB of music, including lofi, rpg music, action/sci fi, 8bit and eastern music Brutal Crushing Difficulty Forests, Wastelands, Port Towns, Medieval Villages, Sprawling Cathedrals, Haunted Villages, Sci Fi Cities, The Kingdom of Heaven Meet religious figures like Buddha, God, Jesus and Sophia A large number of Enemy Types and Variants 70 npcs A powerful character controller, who has a complex combat and movement system, as you get more powerful you can double jump, and eventually fly Melee - Ranged - Magic - Gun Combat An arsenal of powerful weapons A Religious Story Blood and Gore, and dismemberment Certain levels are Procedurally Generated Crude Comedy 3 to 6 hours of gameplay Plenty of Replay Value CCG Card Game Minigame Tac/Tank/Jet Based Combat Minigame 1 life gameplay What a fine day, These demons. Anyway, the game's not really about making money, I made it free so the maximum number of people would get a chance to play it. The maker of this game has schizophrenia, so I am very proud to have gotten this far. Inspired by the teachings of Morgue. [NOTE: The Main Game is not playable in multiplayer, only the CCG Minigame and the Tactical/Tank/Aircraft Minigame are playable in multiplayer]
row.short_description: A roguelike, Soulslike Open World RPG, set in a Labyrinthine Maze of Artifice, the construct world, with all lines fully voiced by Elevenlabs AI Voice Robots, A strange religious poem in game form. Created by one guy, with schizophrenia in Unreal Engine 5.4.
row.notes: The game occasionally takes place in red light districts, and slums where you will encounter prostitutes, consuming narcotics (weed vape), as NPC's you can talk to. In one area of the game the player can purchase the use of a sex worker who unlocks a save game. This edgy content is not found everywhere. There is blood and gore from the combat, and you fight with guns, swords, bows and arrows, and other things. The violence while bloody and gorey, is not intense disturbing violence like some other games. There is swearing and vulgarity in the game, and it even has a button you can press to swear, which also stops the philosophy speeches. Violent and aggressive characters are everywhere throughout the game. The main menu mocks the player, negotiating away the player's soul, then when you press the button to quit, it says "Yes I already took your soul, why not just end it?" Certain maps have comically absurd expletive filled names, for instance, in the tropical region you'll find a map called "BITCH EAT IT IT'S CAKE!!"

row.name: AI Script: Infinite Text Adventures
row.detailed_description: Welcome to 'AI Script: Infinite Text Adventures', an infinite text adventure game powered by an AI Game Master (GM). Experience the future of gaming that captures the magic of classic tabletop role-playing (TRPG), featuring AI-driven, never-repeating storylines and strategic dice-rolls that determine your fate. • An AI Game Master with a Mind of Its Own Your AI GM has its own 'personality'. It might be a generous benefactor, smoothing your path; or it could be a harsh judge, setting daunting challenges for your journey. With each new game, you will face an unknown GM, ready for unexpected surprises and shocks. • An Infinite Universe of Stories At the heart of the game is a powerful AI script generator. It builds worlds for you, generates characters, and weaves completely original storylines. No two adventures are the same, as every choice opens a new narrative branch. • The Soul of TRPG: Strategy & Luck When faced with crucial choices (ABCD) presented by the AI, you must weigh their different success rates. Roll the decisive dice and feel the dramatic tension where strategy meets luck, hanging in the balance between success and failure. • Your Adventure Starts Now The initial version of the game launches with the 'Starship Journey' campaign, taking you to explore the mysteries of the vast cosmos. More diverse script worlds are planned for the future, aiming to expand your horizons of adventure indefinitely (Note: DLC plans are subject to change based on development progress).
row.short_description: An infinite text adventure powered by an AI Game Master. Experience never-repeating generated stories and TRPG-style dice rolls, facing the surprises and challenges from a GM that can be generous or harsh in your 'Starship Journey'.

row.name: Meowment
row.detailed_description: Game Features 3D Side-Scrolling Puzzle Adventure: A unique blend of emotional art style and puzzle gameplay. Journey Between Life and Death: Explore contrasting worlds of vibrant reality and the dark underworld. Diverse Puzzle Mechanics: From moving tuna cans to perspective shifts and toy-based challenges, each stage offers fresh gameplay. Emotional Storytelling: Experience Olive’s journey through the underworld to reunite with Nero, discovering the meaning of farewell and reunion. Challenging yet Seamless Play: Upon death, immediately respawn at the same spot, maintaining tension while ensuring uninterrupted flow. Stage 1: THE KINGDOM OF CANNED TUNA Core Mechanic: Moving Tuna Cans Use tuna cans as platforms to cross bridges, press buttons, and open paths. A beginner-friendly puzzle stage that introduces core mechanics while allowing creative applications. Stage 2: THE REALM OF TOYS Core Mechanic: Action + Toys Features action-based puzzles with rhythm: moving cat towers, rolling yarn balls, and disappearing platforms. Stage 3: THE FOREST OF CATNIP Core Mechanic: Collection + Perspective Shift Switch perspectives to find the hidden Nero and collect catnip to distract enemies. Culminates in a final boss encounter that delivers the story’s emotional resolution.
row.short_description: Cross the underworld in Meowment to find Nero! Solve emotional puzzles, move tuna cans, climb cat towers, shift perspectives, and uncover hidden clues while escaping threats. Experience the dark afterlife and the meaning of parting and reunion.

row.name: Mariposa
row.detailed_description: Mariposa is a 2D puzzle-platformer game that splits you between two worlds—a vibrant past where human society has seemingly progressed beyond the bounds of imagination, having harnessed technology to craft a shining utopia, and the other, a distant future where paradise has crumbled into an abandoned ruin, a wasteland haunted by humanity’s hubris. Follow Mariposa, a young automatonsmith who spends her days picking up various gigs after her shift at the antique store, enthralled with the bright, up-and-coming city. Cheerful, empathetic, and friendly, she’s always here to lend a helping hand! Her latest project? An antique radio that holds more than meets the eye.  When her voice echoes into the weave of time, suddenly this relic of a bygone era bridges the gap between impossibilities, threading a single line of communication from blinding elysium into something much bleaker. Let the everyday become catastrophic and the mundane become life-saving—let the simple flutter of butterfly wings change the winds of fate, forevermore.
row.short_description: Mariposa is a 2D puzzle-platformer game that harnesses the butterfly effect, shaping the past to change the future. Every interaction with Mariposa, an automatonsmith from a utopian past, will billow out into time itself—and guiding a ghost from a forgotten era might be enough to change your fate.
developers: Video Game Development Club @ UC San Diego
publishers: Video Game Development Club @ UC San Diego

row.name: Survive From Museum
row.detailed_description: Banish the countless restless spirits behind the Game Museum, defeat the lingering ghost that guards the place, and survive! Survive From Museum is a casual game with roguelike elements. In moments of growth, your choices will decide between life and death. Hunt monsters, grow stronger, and collect treasures. Survive From Museum is a time-limited survival game featuring casual gameplay with roguelite elements. Survive within the time limit, defeat the spirits, grow stronger, and destroy the lingering ghost to cleanse the back of the museum. In the confined space, there is nowhere to hide or run. At the moment of growth, your choices may grant you the power to stand against the lingering ghost. As a visitor to the Game Museum, you stumble and fall into its underground. There, you encounter a ghost who introduces himself as the Father of Games. He asks you to purify the twisted realm where the souls of monsters from games have gathered. Defeat the familiar yet distorted spirits and the lingering ghost, and escape from the museum! Collect, enhance, and brilliantly evolve 8 different types of weapons. Gather accessories to complete your Codex. Special accessories will grant you unique abilities. Supports mouse and keyboard only. Getting Started Tips When collecting accessories, Yellow > Blue > Green in order of strength. Try acquiring the same weapon multiple times. Dashing can be used to ignore attacks.
row.short_description: Banish the countless restless spirits behind the Game Museum, defeat the lingering ghost that guards the place, and survive! Survive From Museum is a casual game with roguelike elements. In moments of choice, your very life will be decided. Hunt monsters, grow stronger, and collect treasures.

row.name: Gogyō
row.detailed_description: A mix of cards and game board for hours of free fun . Clear, uncluttered menus offer a wealth of possibilities: - a tutorial to learn the rules at your own pace. - play solo against 1 or up to 4 opponents. - a fun Xp system to unlock your game, step by step. - 2 expansions to renew the way you play. - a multiplayer mode to play as a family or take on opponents from all over the world. GamePlay : Chakras are scattered around the game board. To move, 3 types of cards are available: - 'Yin' to move backwards. - 'Yang' to move forward. - 'Karma' to interact with your opponents. Each chakra collected on the element circles (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) makes you a Master of that element. The first Master of 5 elements wins the game.
row.short_description: After so much effort and training, the day of the final test has finally arrived. Under the guidance of Sensei, face off against other disciples to become the sole “Master of the 5 Elements.” To achieve this, be the wisest, the most cunning, or... the fastest!

row.name: Fragments of Dread - False Haven
row.detailed_description: Part 1: False Haven In the first episode, you play as Luca — a young boy staying with his grandmother while his parents are away. What begins as a quiet night soon spirals into a surreal and terrifying experience. After a disturbing phone call, Luca starts questioning everything around him. Is his grandmother really who she says she is? Would you make it through the night? Key Features Short, narrative-driven psychological horror Atmospheric sound design and immersive visuals VHS-inspired aesthetic and UI Real-time interaction via objects and puzzles Controls WASD - Move E - Pick up F - Interact R - In the blink of an eye ESC - Settings Menu
row.short_description: Fragments of Dread is an episodic psychological horror series. Each episode tells a self-contained story of dread, fear, and survival.

row.name: Dungeon Run
row.detailed_description: Navigate through mazes, find chests, and collect 100 unique keys per floor to unlock the path to the next floor. Only the fastest and most cunning adventurers can reach the top! Key Features: 100 Floors of Procedural Mazes: Every run presents a fresh challenge with randomized chest placement. Competitive Key Collection: Collect keys, buy/sell with other players, and strategize to beat the maze before anyone else. Seasonal Competition: Races reset every season, giving everyone a fresh chance to claim the top spots. Are you fast enough to conquer the dungeon and claim your place among the champions? Every decision counts—every second matters. Step in, explore, and race through Dungeon Run .
row.short_description: Race through 100 floors, collect all the keys, and compete for glory!

row.name: Wattson the Bulb
row.detailed_description: About This Game Awaken as a tiny bulb in a strange, beautiful, and hostile world. You remember nothing—only a spark of curiosity and the instinct to survive. As you explore, you’ll recover fragments of your past, master a growing arsenal of abilities, and learn to combine them in creative ways to outsmart enemies, outmaneuver hazards, and open paths you didn’t even know existed. Built around tight, responsive platforming and layered exploration, this metroidvania challenges you to chart your own route through over a hundred hand-crafted stages. Whether you’re a speedrunner hunting for the perfect line or an explorer methodically unveiling every secret, a tough—but fair—adventure awaits. Key Features A unique hero with a forgotten past: Guide a sentient bulb on a journey of self-discovery, piecing together who you were—and who you’ll become—through exploration and play. 10+ unlockable abilities: Dash across chasms, grapple to new heights, wall-climb, reshape your size to slip through tight spaces, conjure platforms, and more. Each power is simple to learn and satisfying to master. Ability combos that reward creativity: Chain moves together to invent your own solutions. Convert a near-miss into momentum, link grapples into aerial routes, or combine size-shifts with movement tech to break through seemingly impossible challenges. 100+ hand-crafted levels: Every area is designed to teach, test, and tempt—shortcuts for the bold, secrets for the curious, and clean routes for those chasing gold. 5+ themed biomes: From neon cityscapes and eerie laboratories to alien cliffs, starlit voids, and slime-soaked caverns, each biome introduces fresh twists, hazards, and surprises. Multiple playstyles supported: Explore at your own pace to unlock every upgrade and secret. Or speed through, mastering routes and shaving seconds off your best times. Challenging but fair: Tight checkpoints, readable hazards, and crisp controls make even the hardest sections feel achievable with practice. Secrets and optional trials: Hidden passages, high-risk time trials, and collectible passages reward mastery without blocking your main path. Controller-first feel: Built for gamepads with snappy input and clean readability. Keyboard play is supported as well. The World The world is bizarre yet cohesive: a patchwork of biomes stitched together by long-forgotten machinery and organic growth. City ruins loom over shimmering laboratories; wind-scoured cliffs give way to subterranean slime nests and star-dusted vistas. Every zone layers new mechanics and visual storytelling on top of your growing toolkit, inviting you to revisit past areas with fresh eyes and newfound skills. Progression You Can Feel Learn, don’t just level: Your strength is defined by knowledge—of routes, of timing, and of your abilities. Each upgrade opens both obvious doors and subtle techniques. Meaningful unlocks: Every ability changes how you move and think, encouraging inventive solutions and enabling elegant, high-skill routes. Non-linear paths: Multiple ways forward, optional challenges, and plenty of reasons to return to earlier zones with a stronger kit. Built for Skimming—and Depth Jump in quickly: Early levels teach by doing, with clear signposting and intuitive hazard design. Mastery at the top end: Advanced tech and clever ability chains let experts express skill and creativity in spectacular ways. Visuals and Feel Crisp, readable art: Environments and hazards are designed for clarity at speed. Distinct biomes: Each area is instantly recognizable, with new platforming concepts and ambient storytelling. Satisfying feedback: Snappy movement, responsive air control, and punchy audio cues make every success feel earned. Perfect for Speedrunners and Explorers Speedrunner-friendly routes: Clean lines, advanced skips (if you can pull them off), and time-focused challenges. Completionist bliss: Hidden rooms, ability-gated secrets, and collectible routes that reward thorough exploration. Accessibility and Options Play your way: Tweak difficulty-related options, adjust visuals and audio, and configure controls to suit your preferences. Fair checkpoints: Practice tricky sections without losing long stretches of progress.
row.short_description: A metroidvania platformer set in a bizarre world. Master unique abilities and combine them in creative ways to overcome challenges over a hundred hand crafted levels. Speed through to find the fastest route or explore at your own pace to unlock everything — a tough but rewarding adventure awaits.

row.name: Aphasie
row.detailed_description: Human madness rises in the form of a tower… Aphasie is an open-world immersive sim of action and stealth that puts you in the role of Mastema, the angel of cataclysms . Evolve within the dynamic environment of the City of Babel, use your powers, stealth, or a wide array of weapons and tools to carve your way to the Tower of Babel. Freedom of action lies at the heart of Aphasie — there is always more than one way to achieve your objective. Main Features: A living and reactive open world: Citizens and guards roam the city and engage in a wide variety of interactions, whether with the player or with each other. The city is filled with tools, quests, and hidden interactions to uncover. Total freedom of approach: Every obstacle in Aphasie can be solved or bypassed in many different ways. Use blades and rifles to fight guards, attempt a stealth approach by disabling alarms, or rely on your powers and the environment to discover new paths. A spear can serve as both a weapon and a platform once embedded in a wall. A tossed gold coin can turn a civilian into a distraction. Hypnosis can transform them into an ally. Varied powers: Your fall from paradise has scattered several of your abilities across the city, it’s up to you whether to recover them or not. Among these supernatural abilities are the power to possess enemies, to create diversions, and many other occult skills. An original artistic direction: The world of Aphasie blends 2D paper-cut and calligram characters with a 3D city inspired by ancient Greece, set upon a colossal aqueduct. The city and its characters evolve within a minimalist universe that highlights key gameplay elements. Available in English and French. Destroy the tower, and reclaim your place in paradise. Music by Loic Dutronc
row.short_description: Aphasie is an open-world immersive sim of action and stealth that puts you in the role of Mastema, the Angel of Cataclysms. Explore the dynamic environment of the city of Babel, use your powers, stealth, or a wide array of weapons and tools to bring down the tower.
row.notes: Contains unrealistic depictions of violence and stylized blood as well as depictions of death and crimes. The death screen mentions a suicide.

row.name: Space way: Echo of the Galaxy Playtest
No More Mages
row.detailed_description: Climb the Tower. Fight the Magic. Slay the Mage. Easy to learn, hard to master Your abilities are straightforward and all are available from the start of the game. However, the clever player can creatively utilize them for advanced movement through levels built to accommodate beginners and pros alike. Players seeking mastery can strive to achieve A or even S rankings on each level, while those wanting less of a challenge can use the assist mode to streamline some of the movement mechanics. Fueled by rage As you destroy objects and collect motes of magic, you’ll collect Rage in order to perform special attacks and recover from damage. Start your Rampage when the Rage meter is filled to fully heal, boost speed, and double all damage. Play well, move faster Maintain your Rampage and rack up a high combo to turn the barbarian from a lumbering brute into a speeding bullet of rage. Curious conversation An introverted savant vs. a boneheaded brute- these begrudging conversational partners have a variety of branching dialogues to explore as the barbarian barges further and further into the mage’s domain.
row.short_description: No More Mages is an action platformer with beat-em-up inspired combat, simple yet hard to master movement, and engaging dialogue. Fight through injury, boost speed, and fuel powerful attacks with Rage. Try to master the speedrunnable levels as you climb the tallest towers to rid the land of magic.

row.name: Project Chromata
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Project Chromata An idle, minimalist sci-fi game with a deep, unfolding mystery. You awaken as the Chroma Engine, a machine built for a single purpose: to create. In a silent, starless void, you must generate fundamental colors, mix them into complex new forms, and reignite the memory of a lost cosmos. Your Directive The universe is empty. Your function is to fill it. By allocating your power and building a vibrant resource engine, you can push back against the perfect nothingness. Each restored star is a new light in the dark and a fragment of a forgotten story, bringing you closer to understanding what was lost. Gameplay Create & Combine: Generate primary colors and unlock complex mixers to build an intricate production chain. Reignite the Stars: Use your creations to generate Light and restore a vast, explorable Star Chart , unlocking powerful, permanent bonuses with each constellation. Automate Everything: Evolve your engine with sophisticated automation to manage production and upgrades, allowing you to focus on cosmic restoration. Discover the Past: Uncover the secrets of the void through fragmented lore entries tied to your progress. From the Developer Thank you for joining the Project Chromata ! The game currently includes the entire first major story arc (Stage 1 & 2), offering a complete and satisfying gameplay experience from start to finish. We are hard at work developing the next massive content update, Stage 3, which will expand the story and introduce entirely new systems. We welcome you to our community and look forward to hearing your feedback as we continue to build upon the universe!
row.short_description: Project Chromata is a deep sci-fi incremental game about restoring the universe by mixing colors. Unlock new technologies, prestige to gain powerful permanent upgrades from a vast star chart, and master automation systems to watch the numbers soar in this satisfying and feature-rich idle experience.

row.name: Walk this road, again

row.name: [Don't] Let Go
row.detailed_description: [Don't] Let Go is a quiet, emotional and atmospheric 3D Action-Adventure Puzzle game. Bound to a mysterious entity by a powerful connection you must work together to solve puzzles, defeat enemies and escape the ancient city. Narrative: You will venture to an ancient and mostly abandoned city located deep within a crater on a journey to see whether the forgotten city is inhabitable for your wandering tribe. Here you will find a mysterious cube with a destructive past that latches onto you, forming a symbiotic rope-like connection. You must use this new found friend to escape the city by solving its many puzzles, avoiding its many threats and allowing the cube to grow. However… all is not as it seems… As the cube grows, it will start to slowly act like an anchor weighing you down and making your escape almost impossible. Do you have what it takes to flee the cursed land… Progression: On your journey you and the mysterious cube will venture to regain its long lost power. By revisiting churches from a past era you can upgrade the cubes power, allowing it to grow in size and strength enabling you to reach new areas and solve more complex puzzles. However... as the cube grows so does its ability to prevent your escape, can you really leave it behind? Goals and Challenges: After successfully locating and abandoned city with potential to be your tribes new home you find yourself unable to leave, the exit blocked by two ancient tentacles. Together with your cube venture to different points in the city to destroy the tentacles, allowing you to flee the cursed land.  Along the way, subordinates of the tentacle will attempt to sever your connection with the cube, imprisoning you both and preventing your escape. Fight multiple different enemy types, forcing you to use the cube in unique ways to defeat them all.  Solve ancient puzzles to unlock new areas and progress through the city on your journey to leave with your new friend.  Primary Game Mechanic: After discovering the cube it forms a unique bond to you, forming a symbiotic rope like connection between the two. Acting like an anchor, the cube and this ancient connection will prevent you from moving far without it, holding you back and limiting your journey. As you go further from the cube your energy will decrease and reliance on it will increase forcing you to stay near it and maintain your energy. The cube is your primary weapon throughout the journey, by throwing it at enemies knock them back and eventually vanish them to push forward and find a way out of the city.  The cube can also be thrown at objects allowing you to alter the environment and solve puzzles to progress further.  Knowing its true power the mystical enemies will try to take the cube from you and return it to the prison from which you found it. Your goal is to protect it and keep it safe, stunning, hitting and defeating all the enemies that block your path and threaten its safety  Playtime: On average it takes new players 1 hour and 30 minutes to beat the game for the first time. At the end of each playthrough you are rewarded with a picture to showcase your achievement. There are 5 of these to collect based on challenges within the game, have fun and good luck! Disclaimers: This is a student game made by 6 people for our final major project at Birmingham City University (2 Designers, 2 Programmers, 1 Artist, 1 Sound Designer). The game is finished and takes a new player around an hour and a half to beat.  [Don't] Let Go has been primarily built for gamepads (Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo controllers) please use one of those for the best experience, we do not advise using a keyboard.

Play it now for free, then come back during Steam Next Fest for the full demo with roguelite progression, companion allies, loads of equipment and upgrades, and more bosses to conquer. Developer's Note Hi everyone, I’m Jorge Rodriguez, the developer of Eclipse Breaker. This project is my tribute to the roguelites and PlayStation-era RPGs that defined my love of games, blending fast-paced, timing-driven battles with the sense of mystery and danger I grew up chasing. I've had a lot of fun developing this game, and it’s been a joy to bring that idea to life. The minigame you’re about to play is just one game mode available in the full release, and your feedback is incredibly valuable as we keep building toward the launch later this year. Whether you’re here for the strategic combat, the nostalgia, or to test your skills against impossible odds, thank you for giving Eclipse Breaker a try. Now go face the challenge, and see how long you can last!
